ko.title: 중간선거 자금 기계: 선거 막판, 선거 광고비는 어디로 흐르는가

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3 less than a month away, the last stretch of the 2026 midterm campaign is also its most expensive.
segments.tr: 11월 3일 선거일까지 한 달도 채 남지 않은 지금, 2026년 중간선거의 마지막 구간은 가장 많은 비용이 드는 시기이기도 합니다.

segments.src: Candidates, party committees and outside groups are all competing for a limited supply of airtime, inbox space and phone screens.
segments.tr: 후보자, 정당 위원회, 외부 단체 모두 제한된 방송 시간, 이메일 수신함 공간, 휴대폰 화면을 차지하기 위해 경쟁하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Here is where the money tends to go in the closing weeks, and what those choices reveal about how each side reads the political map.
segments.tr: 선거 막판에 자금이 주로 어디로 흘러가는지, 그리고 그러한 선택이 각 진영이 정치 지형을 어떻게 읽고 있는지를 어떻게 보여주는지 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: *Note: This article is a general explainer.
segments.tr: *참고: 이 기사는 일반적인 설명 자료입니다.

segments.src: Spending totals change daily, so check ad-tracking firms and the Federal Election Commission (FEC) for current figures.*
segments.tr: 지출 총액은 매일 변동되므로, 최신 수치는 광고 추적 업체와 연방선거위원회(FEC)를 확인하시기 바랍니다.*

segments.src: ## Why the final weeks cost the most
segments.tr: ## 막판에 비용이 가장 많이 드는 이유

segments.src: Political advertising follows a predictable pattern.
segments.tr: 정치 광고는 예측 가능한 패턴을 따릅니다.

segments.src: Spending ramps up as Election Day approaches, and the last few weeks are the most crowded.
segments.tr: 선거일이 다가올수록 지출은 급증하며, 마지막 몇 주가 가장 혼잡합니다.

segments.src: There are a few reasons:
segments.tr: 여기에는 몇 가지 이유가 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Voters are paying attention.** Many people tune in only when early voting begins and ballots arrive in the mail.
segments.tr: - **유권자들의 관심 집중.** 많은 사람들이 사전 투표가 시작되고 우편으로 투표용지가 도착할 때 비로소 관심을 갖기 시작합니다.

segments.src: - **Early voting compresses the calendar.** In many states, voting is already underway, so a message has to land before ballots are returned, not just before Election Day.
segments.tr: - **사전 투표로 인한 일정 압축.** 많은 주에서 이미 투표가 진행 중이므로, 메시지는 선거일 직전이 아니라 투표용지가 반송되기 전에 전달되어야 합니다.

segments.src: - **Rates rise with demand.** Broadcast stations sell time in a competitive market, and prices tend to climb when many campaigns want the same slots. Federal candidates get legal protections on the rates they pay, but outside groups often pay more.
segments.tr: - **수요에 따른 요금 상승.** 방송국은 경쟁 시장에서 시간을 판매하며, 많은 캠프가 동일한 시간대를 원할 때 가격이 오르는 경향이 있습니다. 연방 후보자는 지불하는 요금에 대해 법적 보호를 받지만, 외부 단체는 더 많은 비용을 지불하는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: ## Where the dollars go
segments.tr: ## 자금의 흐름

segments.src: ### Broadcast and cable television
segments.tr: ### 지상파 및 케이블 TV

segments.src: Local broadcast TV is still the largest single line item in most competitive races.
segments.tr: 지역 지상파 TV는 여전히 대부분의 치열한 선거구에서 가장 큰 단일 지출 항목입니다.

segments.src: It reaches older, high-turnout voters efficiently, and those voters make up a large share of midterm electorates.
segments.tr: 이 매체는 투표율이 높은 고령 유권자들에게 효율적으로 도달하며, 이들은 중간선거 유권자의 큰 비중을 차지합니다.

segments.src: Costs are highest in expensive media markets, and a statewide race in a large state can require buying time in several of them.
segments.tr: 비용은 미디어 시장 규모가 클수록 가장 높으며, 대규모 주에서의 주 전체 선거는 여러 시장에서 광고 시간을 구매해야 할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Streaming and connected TV
segments.tr: ### 스트리밍 및 커넥티드 TV

segments.src: Connected TV, which includes ads served on streaming services and smart-TV platforms, has become a fast-growing part of campaign budgets.
segments.tr: 스트리밍 서비스와 스마트 TV 플랫폼에서 제공되는 광고를 포함하는 커넥티드 TV는 선거 캠페인 예산에서 빠르게 성장하는 부분이 되었습니다.

segments.src: Its main appeal is targeting.
segments.tr: 주요 장점은 타겟팅입니다.

segments.src: A campaign can aim at a specific geography or audience instead of paying for every viewer in a market.
segments.tr: 캠프는 시장의 모든 시청자에게 비용을 지불하는 대신 특정 지역이나 특정 청중을 겨냥할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Streaming does not replace broadcast, but many strategists now treat it as a complement, especially for reaching viewers who rarely watch live television.
segments.tr: 스트리밍이 지상파를 대체하는 것은 아니지만, 많은 전략가들은 이제 이를 보완재로 취급하며, 특히 실시간 TV를 거의 시청하지 않는 시청자에게 도달하기 위해 활용합니다.

segments.src: ### Digital and social
segments.tr: ### 디지털 및 소셜 미디어

segments.src: Online display, search, video and social ads serve several purposes.
segments.tr: 온라인 디스플레이, 검색, 동영상 및 소셜 광고는 여러 목적을 수행합니다.

segments.src: Some are persuasion messages.
segments.tr: 일부는 설득을 위한 메시지입니다.

segments.src: Others raise money, recruit volunteers or remind supporters how and where to vote.
segments.tr: 다른 광고들은 모금을 하거나, 자원봉사자를 모집하거나, 지지자들에게 투표 방법과 장소를 상기시킵니다.

segments.src: Major platforms set their own rules for political ads, including disclosure requirements and, in some cases, restrictions in the final days before an election, so campaigns plan their digital calendars carefully.
segments.tr: 주요 플랫폼들은 정치 광고에 대한 자체 규칙을 설정하고 있으며, 여기에는 공개 요구 사항과 경우에 따라 선거 직전 며칠 동안의 제한 사항이 포함되므로 캠프는 디지털 일정을 신중하게 계획합니다.

segments.src: ### Text, mail and direct outreach
segments.tr: ### 문자, 우편 및 직접 홍보

segments.src: Texting, direct mail and phone outreach are less visible than TV but central to turnout efforts.
segments.tr: 문자 메시지, 직접 우편, 전화 홍보는 TV보다 눈에 덜 띄지만 투표 독려 활동의 핵심입니다.

segments.src: In the closing weeks, they are used to provide polling-place information, promote early voting and urge supporters to return mail ballots.
segments.tr: 선거 막판에는 투표소 정보 제공, 사전 투표 홍보, 지지자들의 우편 투표용지 반송 독려에 사용됩니다.

segments.src: Campaigns must comply with federal and state rules on messaging and consent, and responsible operations build those compliance steps into their programs.
segments.tr: 캠프는 메시지 발송 및 동의에 관한 연방 및 주 규칙을 준수해야 하며, 책임 있는 운영진은 이러한 규정 준수 단계를 프로그램에 포함시킵니다.

segments.src: ## Which races absorb the most money
segments.tr: ## 가장 많은 자금이 투입되는 선거

segments.src: Ad money is not spread evenly.
segments.tr: 광고 자금은 고르게 분산되지 않습니다.

segments.src: It concentrates in a small number of contests that are close enough for spending to plausibly change the outcome.
segments.tr: 지출을 통해 결과를 바꿀 가능성이 있는, 박빙의 승부가 펼쳐지는 소수의 선거구에 집중됩니다.

segments.src: - **Competitive U.S. Senate races.** Statewide contests in battleground states draw the most spending because they cover multiple media markets and can decide control of the chamber.
segments.tr: - **치열한 미국 상원 선거.** 격전지의 주 전체 선거는 여러 미디어 시장을 포괄하고 상원 다수당 지위를 결정할 수 있기 때문에 가장 많은 지출을 유발합니다.

segments.src: - **Governor's races.** Open seats and tight contests in large states can produce enormous ad budgets.
segments.tr: - **주지사 선거.** 대규모 주에서 공석이거나 접전인 경우 엄청난 광고 예산이 투입될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Key U.S. House districts.** Control of the House typically turns on a few dozen competitive seats. Party committees and affiliated super PACs often spend heavily in those districts, particularly in expensive markets such as the New York and Los Angeles areas, where TV costs are high.
segments.tr: - **핵심 미국 하원 선거구.** 하원 다수당 지위는 보통 수십 개의 경쟁 선거구에서 결정됩니다. 정당 위원회와 관련 슈퍼 PAC(정치활동위원회)는 종종 해당 선거구에 막대한 비용을 지출하며, 특히 TV 비용이 높은 뉴욕 및 로스앤젤레스 지역과 같은 비싼 시장에서 더욱 그렇습니다.

segments.src: - **Ballot measures.** In some states, referendums and initiatives on issues such as taxes, abortion access or election rules attract eight-figure campaigns of their own.
segments.tr: - **주민 발의안.** 일부 주에서는 세금, 낙태 접근권, 선거 규칙과 같은 문제에 대한 국민투표나 발의안이 그 자체로 수천만 달러 규모의 캠페인을 유치하기도 합니다.

segments.src: ## What the spending says about the map
segments.tr: ## 지출이 보여주는 정치 지형

segments.src: Strategists often say that where a group puts its money is the clearest signal of what it believes.
segments.tr: 전략가들은 종종 단체가 자금을 어디에 투입하는지가 그들이 무엇을 믿는지 보여주는 가장 명확한 신호라고 말합니다.

segments.src: Reading the spending patterns can offer a few clues.
segments.tr: 지출 패턴을 읽으면 몇 가지 단서를 얻을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **Defense versus offense.** When a party or allied group books time in a district it usually wins, it is typically playing defense and worried about erosion there.
segments.tr: **방어 대 공격.** 정당이나 연합 단체가 보통 승리하는 선거구에 광고 시간을 예약할 때, 이는 일반적으로 방어적인 태세이며 그곳에서의 지지율 하락을 우려하고 있다는 뜻입니다.

segments.src: Money in territory the other side holds suggests confidence that the seat is within reach.
segments.tr: 상대 진영이 보유한 지역에 자금을 투입하는 것은 해당 의석을 차지할 수 있다는 자신감을 시사합니다.

segments.src: Shifts from week to week, such as a group canceling reservations in one race and adding them in another, are closely watched as a sign of internal polling.
segments.tr: 한 선거구의 예약을 취소하고 다른 선거구에 추가하는 등 주 단위의 변화는 내부 여론조사 결과의 신호로 면밀히 관찰됩니다.

segments.src: **Expanding or shrinking the battlefield.** Late reservations in a race that was not on the radar months ago suggest the map is widening.
segments.tr: **전장 확대 또는 축소.** 몇 달 전에는 고려 대상이 아니었던 선거구에 막판 예약을 하는 것은 전장이 넓어지고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: Pulled reservations may mean a campaign has concluded a race is either safe or out of reach.
segments.tr: 예약을 철회하는 것은 캠프가 해당 선거를 이미 안전하거나 승산이 없다고 결론 내렸음을 의미할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **The role of outside groups.** Super PACs and other outside organizations can raise large sums and often fill gaps that candidate committees cannot, particularly because candidates and parties have contribution limits that outside groups do not.
segments.tr: **외부 단체의 역할.** 슈퍼 PAC 및 기타 외부 조직은 거액을 모금할 수 있으며, 후보자 위원회와 정당은 기부금 한도가 있는 반면 외부 단체는 그렇지 않기 때문에 종종 후보자 위원회가 할 수 없는 공백을 메웁니다.

segments.src: Some of these groups disclose donors; others, such as certain nonprofits, have more limited disclosure.
segments.tr: 이러한 단체 중 일부는 기부자를 공개하지만, 특정 비영리 단체와 같은 다른 단체들은 공개 범위가 더 제한적입니다.

segments.src: That is one reason transparency advocates keep a close eye on the final-month filings.
segments.tr: 이것이 투명성 옹호자들이 마지막 달의 보고서를 면밀히 주시하는 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: **Candidate fundraising strength.** In some races, one candidate has a clear fundraising advantage.
segments.tr: **후보자의 모금 능력.** 일부 선거에서는 한 후보자가 확실한 모금 우위를 점하고 있습니다.

segments.src: In others, the candidate who is behind on money is helped by party or outside spending that narrows the gap on the air.
segments.tr: 다른 선거에서는 자금이 부족한 후보자가 정당이나 외부 지출의 도움을 받아 방송 광고 격차를 좁히기도 합니다.

segments.src: ## What viewers and voters should know
segments.tr: ## 시청자와 유권자가 알아야 할 사항

segments.src: - **Check the disclaimer.** Federal ads must state who paid for them. "Paid for by..." and "I approve this message" lines show whether an ad came from a candidate, a party committee or an outside group.
segments.tr: - **면책 조항 확인.** 연방 광고는 누가 비용을 지불했는지 명시해야 합니다. "Paid for by..."(지불 주체) 및 "I approve this message"(후보자 승인) 문구는 해당 광고가 후보자, 정당 위원회, 외부 단체 중 어디에서 나왔는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: - **Look up the sponsor.** The FEC database and state election offices publish campaign finance reports, and independent trackers publish ad-spending data.
segments.tr: - **후원자 조회.** FEC 데이터베이스와 주 선거 관리 사무소는 선거 자금 보고서를 게시하며, 독립적인 추적 기관들은 광고 지출 데이터를 게시합니다.

segments.src: - **Remember that an ad is advocacy.** Campaign ads are designed to persuade. Claims about opponents are often selective, and fact-checking organizations and nonpartisan voter guides can help provide context.
segments.tr: - **광고는 옹호 활동임을 기억.** 선거 광고는 설득을 위해 설계되었습니다. 상대방에 대한 주장은 종종 선택적일 수 있으며, 팩트체크 기관과 비당파적 유권자 가이드가 맥락을 파악하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote.** Rules on early voting, mail ballots and registration deadlines vary by state. Your state or local election office is the most reliable source for dates and locations.
segments.tr: - **투표 계획 수립.** 사전 투표, 우편 투표, 등록 마감일에 관한 규칙은 주마다 다릅니다. 주 또는 지역 선거 관리 사무소는 날짜와 장소에 대한 가장 신뢰할 수 있는 출처입니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The late-campaign surge in political advertising is a reminder that elections are shaped by both messages and logistics.
segments.tr: 선거 막판의 정치 광고 급증은 선거가 메시지와 물류 모두에 의해 형성된다는 점을 상기시켜 줍니다.

segments.src: Which markets get ads, which screens are targeted and which races attract outside money all reflect each side's view of where the next majority will be won or lost.
segments.tr: 어떤 시장에 광고를 내보내고, 어떤 화면을 타겟팅하며, 어떤 선거구가 외부 자금을 끌어들이는지는 모두 다음 다수당이 어디에서 승리하거나 패배할지에 대한 각 진영의 견해를 반영합니다.

segments.src: By Election Day, the spending map will say a lot about what campaigns believed was in play, even before the votes are counted.
segments.tr: 선거일이 되면, 지출 지도는 표가 집계되기 전부터 캠프들이 무엇을 승부처로 생각했는지에 대해 많은 것을 말해줄 것입니다.

segments.src: ## Why the final weeks cost the most
segments.tr: ## 为什么最后几周花费最高

segments.src: Political advertising follows a predictable pattern.
segments.tr: 政治广告遵循一种可预测的模式。

segments.src: Spending ramps up as Election Day approaches, and the last few weeks are the most crowded.
segments.tr: 随着选举日的临近，支出会增加，最后几周最为拥挤。

segments.src: There are a few reasons:
segments.tr: 原因有几点：

segments.src: - **Voters are paying attention.** Many people tune in only when early voting begins and ballots arrive in the mail.
segments.tr: - **选民正在关注。** 许多人只有在提前投票开始、选票寄到家中时才会开始关注。

segments.src: - **Early voting compresses the calendar.** In many states, voting is already underway, so a message has to land before ballots are returned, not just before Election Day.
segments.tr: - **提前投票压缩了时间表。** 在许多州，投票已经开始，因此信息必须在选票寄回之前传达，而不仅仅是在选举日之前。

segments.src: - **Rates rise with demand.** Broadcast stations sell time in a competitive market, and prices tend to climb when many campaigns want the same slots. Federal candidates get legal protections on the rates they pay, but outside groups often pay more.
segments.tr: - **费率随需求上升。** 广播电台在一个竞争激烈的市场中出售时段，当许多竞选活动需要相同的时段时，价格往往会上涨。联邦候选人在支付费率方面享有法律保护，但外部团体通常支付更多。

segments.src: ## Where the dollars go
segments.tr: ## 资金流向何处

segments.src: ### Broadcast and cable television
segments.tr: ### 广播和有线电视

segments.src: Local broadcast TV is still the largest single line item in most competitive races.
segments.tr: 在大多数竞争激烈的选战中，本地广播电视仍然是最大的单一支出项目。

segments.src: It reaches older, high-turnout voters efficiently, and those voters make up a large share of midterm electorates.
segments.tr: 它能有效地触达年龄较大、投票率高的选民，而这些选民在中期选举的选民群体中占很大比例。

segments.src: Costs are highest in expensive media markets, and a statewide race in a large state can require buying time in several of them.
segments.tr: 在昂贵的媒体市场中成本最高，而在大州进行的州级竞选可能需要在多个市场购买时段。

segments.src: ### Streaming and connected TV
segments.tr: ### 流媒体和联网电视

segments.src: Connected TV, which includes ads served on streaming services and smart-TV platforms, has become a fast-growing part of campaign budgets.
segments.tr: 联网电视（包括在流媒体服务和智能电视平台上投放的广告）已成为竞选预算中增长最快的部分。

segments.src: Its main appeal is targeting.
segments.tr: 其主要吸引力在于精准投放。

segments.src: A campaign can aim at a specific geography or audience instead of paying for every viewer in a market.
segments.tr: 竞选活动可以针对特定的地理位置或受众，而不是为市场中的每一位观众付费。

segments.src: Streaming does not replace broadcast, but many strategists now treat it as a complement, especially for reaching viewers who rarely watch live television.
segments.tr: 流媒体并不能取代广播，但许多策略师现在将其视为一种补充，特别是对于触达那些很少观看直播电视的观众而言。

segments.src: ### Digital and social
segments.tr: ### 数字和社交媒体

segments.src: Online display, search, video and social ads serve several purposes.
segments.tr: 在线展示、搜索、视频和社交广告有多种用途。

segments.src: Some are persuasion messages.
segments.tr: 有些是说服性信息。

segments.src: Others raise money, recruit volunteers or remind supporters how and where to vote.
segments.tr: 另一些则用于筹款、招募志愿者或提醒支持者如何以及在哪里投票。

segments.src: Major platforms set their own rules for political ads, including disclosure requirements and, in some cases, restrictions in the final days before an election, so campaigns plan their digital calendars carefully.
segments.tr: 主要平台为政治广告制定了自己的规则，包括披露要求，在某些情况下，还包括在选举前最后几天的限制，因此竞选团队会仔细规划他们的数字日程。

segments.src: ### Text, mail and direct outreach
segments.tr: ### 短信、邮件和直接外联

segments.src: Texting, direct mail and phone outreach are less visible than TV but central to turnout efforts.
segments.tr: 短信、直邮和电话外联虽然不如电视显眼，但却是动员工作的核心。

segments.src: In the closing weeks, they are used to provide polling-place information, promote early voting and urge supporters to return mail ballots.
segments.tr: 在最后几周，它们被用于提供投票站信息、推广提前投票并敦促支持者寄回邮寄选票。

segments.src: Campaigns must comply with federal and state rules on messaging and consent, and responsible operations build those compliance steps into their programs.
segments.tr: 竞选团队必须遵守联邦和州关于信息传递和同意的规定，负责任的运营方会将这些合规步骤纳入其计划中。

segments.src: ## Which races absorb the most money
segments.tr: ## 哪些选战吸收了最多的资金

segments.src: Ad money is not spread evenly.
segments.tr: 广告资金并非均匀分布。

segments.src: It concentrates in a small number of contests that are close enough for spending to plausibly change the outcome.
segments.tr: 它集中在少数几场竞争激烈的选战中，这些选战的胜负差距小到足以让支出改变结果。

segments.src: - **Competitive U.S. Senate races.** Statewide contests in battleground states draw the most spending because they cover multiple media markets and can decide control of the chamber.
segments.tr: - **竞争激烈的美国参议院选战。** 摇摆州的州级竞选吸引了最多的支出，因为它们覆盖多个媒体市场，并可能决定参议院的控制权。

segments.src: - **Governor's races.** Open seats and tight contests in large states can produce enormous ad budgets.
segments.tr: - **州长竞选。** 大州的空缺席位和胶着选战可能会产生巨大的广告预算。

segments.src: - **Key U.S. House districts.** Control of the House typically turns on a few dozen competitive seats. Party committees and affiliated super PACs often spend heavily in those districts, particularly in expensive markets such as the New York and Los Angeles areas, where TV costs are high.
segments.tr: - **关键的美国众议院选区。** 众议院的控制权通常取决于几十个竞争激烈的席位。政党委员会和附属的超级政治行动委员会 (super PACs) 经常在这些选区投入巨资，特别是在纽约和洛杉矶等昂贵的市场，那里的电视成本很高。

segments.src: - **Ballot measures.** In some states, referendums and initiatives on issues such as taxes, abortion access or election rules attract eight-figure campaigns of their own.
segments.tr: - **投票提案。** 在一些州，关于税收、堕胎权或选举规则等议题的公投和倡议，本身就能吸引千万美元级别的竞选活动。

segments.src: ## What the spending says about the map
segments.tr: ## 支出说明了什么版图

segments.src: Strategists often say that where a group puts its money is the clearest signal of what it believes.
segments.tr: 策略师常说，一个团体把钱花在哪里，就是它信念的最清晰信号。

segments.src: Reading the spending patterns can offer a few clues.
segments.tr: 解读支出模式可以提供一些线索。

segments.src: **Defense versus offense.** When a party or allied group books time in a district it usually wins, it is typically playing defense and worried about erosion there.
segments.tr: **防守与进攻。** 当一个政党或盟友团体在通常能赢的选区预订时段时，它通常是在进行防守，并担心那里的支持率流失。

segments.src: Money in territory the other side holds suggests confidence that the seat is within reach.
segments.tr: 在对方控制的领土上投入资金，表明有信心该席位触手可及。

segments.src: Shifts from week to week, such as a group canceling reservations in one race and adding them in another, are closely watched as a sign of internal polling.
segments.tr: 每周的变化，例如一个团体取消一场选战的预订并增加另一场，被密切关注作为内部民调的信号。

segments.src: **Expanding or shrinking the battlefield.** Late reservations in a race that was not on the radar months ago suggest the map is widening.
segments.tr: **扩大或缩小战场。** 在几个月前未被关注的选战中出现的后期预订，表明版图正在扩大。

segments.src: Pulled reservations may mean a campaign has concluded a race is either safe or out of reach.
segments.tr: 撤回预订可能意味着竞选团队已断定一场选战要么是安全的，要么是无法触及的。

segments.src: **The role of outside groups.** Super PACs and other outside organizations can raise large sums and often fill gaps that candidate committees cannot, particularly because candidates and parties have contribution limits that outside groups do not.
segments.tr: **外部团体的角色。** 超级政治行动委员会 (super PACs) 和其他外部组织可以筹集巨额资金，并经常填补候选人委员会无法填补的空白，特别是由于候选人和政党有捐款限制，而外部团体没有。

segments.src: Some of these groups disclose donors; others, such as certain nonprofits, have more limited disclosure.
segments.tr: 其中一些团体披露捐赠者；而另一些，如某些非营利组织，披露程度有限。

segments.src: That is one reason transparency advocates keep a close eye on the final-month filings.
segments.tr: 这就是透明度倡导者密切关注最后一个月备案文件的原因之一。

segments.src: **Candidate fundraising strength.** In some races, one candidate has a clear fundraising advantage.
segments.tr: **候选人的筹款实力。** 在一些选战中，一名候选人拥有明显的筹款优势。

segments.src: In others, the candidate who is behind on money is helped by party or outside spending that narrows the gap on the air.
segments.tr: 在另一些选战中，资金落后的候选人会得到政党或外部支出的帮助，从而缩小在广播上的差距。

segments.src: ## What viewers and voters should know
segments.tr: ## 观众和选民应该知道什么

segments.src: - **Check the disclaimer.** Federal ads must state who paid for them. "Paid for by..." and "I approve this message" lines show whether an ad came from a candidate, a party committee or an outside group.
segments.tr: - **查看免责声明。** 联邦广告必须说明谁为广告付费。“Paid for by...”和“I approve this message”字样显示广告是来自候选人、政党委员会还是外部团体。

segments.src: - **Look up the sponsor.** The FEC database and state election offices publish campaign finance reports, and independent trackers publish ad-spending data.
segments.tr: - **查询赞助商。** FEC 数据库和州选举办公室发布竞选财务报告，独立追踪机构发布广告支出数据。

segments.src: - **Remember that an ad is advocacy.** Campaign ads are designed to persuade. Claims about opponents are often selective, and fact-checking organizations and nonpartisan voter guides can help provide context.
segments.tr: - **记住广告是宣传。** 竞选广告旨在说服。关于对手的说法往往是有选择性的，事实核查组织和无党派选民指南可以帮助提供背景信息。

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote.** Rules on early voting, mail ballots and registration deadlines vary by state. Your state or local election office is the most reliable source for dates and locations.
segments.tr: - **制定投票计划。** 关于提前投票、邮寄选票和注册截止日期的规则因州而异。您所在的州或地方选举办公室是日期和地点的最可靠来源。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The late-campaign surge in political advertising is a reminder that elections are shaped by both messages and logistics.
segments.tr: 竞选后期政治广告的激增提醒我们，选举是由信息和后勤共同塑造的。

segments.src: Which markets get ads, which screens are targeted and which races attract outside money all reflect each side's view of where the next majority will be won or lost.
segments.tr: 哪些市场投放广告、哪些屏幕被锁定以及哪些选战吸引了外部资金，都反映了双方对下一个多数席位将在何处赢得或失去的看法。

segments.src: By Election Day, the spending map will say a lot about what campaigns believed was in play, even before the votes are counted.
segments.tr: 到选举日时，支出版图将充分说明竞选团队认为哪些选战存在变数，甚至在选票统计之前就已经显现。

es.title: La máquina del dinero en las elecciones de medio término: a dónde fluyen los dólares de anuncios de campaña en las últimas semanas

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3 less than a month away, the last stretch of the 2026 midterm campaign is also its most expensive.
segments.tr: Faltando menos de un mes para el día de las elecciones, el 3 de noviembre, el tramo final de la campaña de medio término de 2026 es también el más costoso.

segments.src: Candidates, party committees and outside groups are all competing for a limited supply of airtime, inbox space and phone screens.
segments.tr: Candidatos, comités de partido y grupos externos compiten por un suministro limitado de tiempo en aire, espacio en bandejas de entrada y pantallas de teléfonos.

segments.src: Here is where the money tends to go in the closing weeks, and what those choices reveal about how each side reads the political map.
segments.tr: Aquí es a dónde tiende a ir el dinero en las semanas finales, y lo que esas elecciones revelan sobre cómo cada bando lee el mapa político.

segments.tr: *Nota: Este artículo es una explicación general.

segments.src: Spending totals change daily, so check ad-tracking firms and the Federal Election Commission (FEC) for current figures.*
segments.tr: Los totales de gasto cambian a diario, por lo que se recomienda consultar a las firmas de seguimiento de anuncios y a la Comisión Federal de Elecciones (FEC) para obtener cifras actuales.*

segments.src: ## Why the final weeks cost the most
segments.tr: ## Por qué las últimas semanas cuestan más

segments.src: Political advertising follows a predictable pattern.
segments.tr: La publicidad política sigue un patrón predecible.

segments.src: Spending ramps up as Election Day approaches, and the last few weeks are the most crowded.
segments.tr: El gasto se intensifica a medida que se acerca el día de las elecciones, y las últimas semanas son las más saturadas.

segments.src: There are a few reasons:
segments.tr: Hay varias razones:

segments.src: - **Voters are paying attention.** Many people tune in only when early voting begins and ballots arrive in the mail.
segments.tr: - **Los votantes están prestando atención.** Muchas personas se sintonizan solo cuando comienza la votación anticipada y las papeletas llegan por correo.

segments.src: - **Early voting compresses the calendar.** In many states, voting is already underway, so a message has to land before ballots are returned, not just before Election Day.
segments.tr: - **La votación anticipada comprime el calendario.** En muchos estados, la votación ya está en marcha, por lo que un mensaje debe llegar antes de que se devuelvan las papeletas, no solo antes del día de las elecciones.

segments.src: - **Rates rise with demand.** Broadcast stations sell time in a competitive market, and prices tend to climb when many campaigns want the same slots. Federal candidates get legal protections on the rates they pay, but outside groups often pay more.
segments.tr: - **Las tarifas aumentan con la demanda.** Las estaciones de radiodifusión venden tiempo en un mercado competitivo, y los precios tienden a subir cuando muchas campañas quieren los mismos espacios. Los candidatos federales obtienen protecciones legales en las tarifas que pagan, pero los grupos externos a menudo pagan más.

segments.src: ## Where the dollars go
segments.tr: ## A dónde van los dólares

segments.src: ### Broadcast and cable television
segments.tr: ### Televisión de señal abierta y por cable

segments.src: Local broadcast TV is still the largest single line item in most competitive races.
segments.tr: La televisión de señal abierta local sigue siendo el rubro individual más grande en la mayoría de las contienda competitivas.

segments.src: It reaches older, high-turnout voters efficiently, and those voters make up a large share of midterm electorates.
segments.tr: Llega de manera eficiente a los votantes mayores con alta participación, y esos votantes representan una gran proporción de los electorados de medio término.

segments.src: Costs are highest in expensive media markets, and a statewide race in a large state can require buying time in several of them.
segments.tr: Los costos son más altos en mercados de medios costosos, y una carrera a nivel estatal en un estado grande puede requerir la compra de tiempo en varios de ellos.

segments.src: ### Streaming and connected TV
segments.tr: ### Streaming y TV conectada

segments.src: Connected TV, which includes ads served on streaming services and smart-TV platforms, has become a fast-growing part of campaign budgets.
segments.tr: La TV conectada, que incluye anuncios mostrados en servicios de streaming y plataformas de smart-TV, se ha convertido en una parte de rápido crecimiento en los presupuestos de campaña.

segments.src: Its main appeal is targeting.
segments.tr: Su principal atractivo es la segmentación.

segments.src: A campaign can aim at a specific geography or audience instead of paying for every viewer in a market.
segments.tr: Una campaña puede dirigirse a una geografía o audiencia específica en lugar de pagar por cada espectador en un mercado.

segments.src: Streaming does not replace broadcast, but many strategists now treat it as a complement, especially for reaching viewers who rarely watch live television.
segments.tr: El streaming no reemplaza a la televisión tradicional, pero muchos estrategas ahora lo tratan como un complemento, especialmente para llegar a espectadores que rara vez ven televisión en vivo.

segments.src: ### Digital and social
segments.tr: ### Digital y redes sociales

segments.src: Online display, search, video and social ads serve several purposes.
segments.tr: Los anuncios en línea de display, búsqueda, video y redes sociales cumplen con varios propósitos.

segments.src: Some are persuasion messages.
segments.tr: Algunos son mensajes de persuasión.

segments.src: Others raise money, recruit volunteers or remind supporters how and where to vote.
segments.tr: Otros recaudan dinero, reclutan voluntarios o recuerdan a los simpatizantes cómo y dónde votar.

segments.src: Major platforms set their own rules for political ads, including disclosure requirements and, in some cases, restrictions in the final days before an election, so campaigns plan their digital calendars carefully.
segments.tr: Las principales plataformas establecen sus propias reglas para los anuncios políticos, incluidos los requisitos de divulgación y, en algunos casos, restricciones en los días finales previos a una elección, por lo que las campañas planifican cuidadosamente sus calendarios digitales.

segments.src: ### Text, mail and direct outreach
segments.tr: ### Mensajes de texto, correo postal y contacto directo

segments.src: Texting, direct mail and phone outreach are less visible than TV but central to turnout efforts.
segments.tr: Los mensajes de texto, el correo directo y el contacto telefónico son menos visibles que la televisión, pero fundamentales para los esfuerzos de movilización.

segments.src: In the closing weeks, they are used to provide polling-place information, promote early voting and urge supporters to return mail ballots.
segments.tr: En las semanas finales, se utilizan para proporcionar información sobre los centros de votación, promover la votación anticipada e instar a los simpatizantes a devolver las papeletas por correo.

segments.src: Campaigns must comply with federal and state rules on messaging and consent, and responsible operations build those compliance steps into their programs.
segments.tr: Las campañas deben cumplir con las reglas federales y estatales sobre mensajería y consentimiento, y las operaciones responsables integran esos pasos de cumplimiento en sus programas.

segments.src: ## Which races absorb the most money
segments.tr: ## Qué contiendas absorben la mayor cantidad de dinero

segments.src: Ad money is not spread evenly.
segments.tr: El dinero de la publicidad no se distribuye por igual.

segments.src: It concentrates in a small number of contests that are close enough for spending to plausibly change the outcome.
segments.tr: Se concentra en un pequeño número de contiendas que están lo suficientemente ajustadas como para que el gasto pueda cambiar plausiblemente el resultado.

segments.src: - **Competitive U.S. Senate races.** Statewide contests in battleground states draw the most spending because they cover multiple media markets and can decide control of the chamber.
segments.tr: - **Contiendas competitivas para el Senado de EE. UU.** Las elecciones a nivel estatal en estados clave atraen el mayor gasto porque cubren múltiples mercados de medios y pueden decidir el control de la cámara.

segments.src: - **Governor's races.** Open seats and tight contests in large states can produce enormous ad budgets.
segments.tr: - **Elecciones para gobernador.** Los puestos vacantes y las contiendas reñidas en estados grandes pueden generar presupuestos publicitarios enormes.

segments.src: - **Key U.S. House districts.** Control of the House typically turns on a few dozen competitive seats. Party committees and affiliated super PACs often spend heavily in those districts, particularly in expensive markets such as the New York and Los Angeles areas, where TV costs are high.
segments.tr: - **Distritos clave para la Cámara de Representantes de EE. UU.** El control de la Cámara de Representantes suele depender de unas pocas docenas de escaños competitivos. Los comités de partido y los super PAC afiliados a menudo gastan fuertemente en esos distritos, particularmente en mercados costosos como las áreas de New York y Los Angeles, donde los costos de televisión son altos.

segments.src: - **Ballot measures.** In some states, referendums and initiatives on issues such as taxes, abortion access or election rules attract eight-figure campaigns of their own.
segments.tr: - **Iniciativas en la papeleta.** En algunos estados, los referéndums e iniciativas sobre temas como impuestos, acceso al aborto o reglas electorales atraen por sí mismos campañas de ocho cifras.

segments.src: ## What the spending says about the map
segments.tr: ## Lo que el gasto dice sobre el mapa

segments.src: Strategists often say that where a group puts its money is the clearest signal of what it believes.
segments.tr: Los estrategas suelen decir que el lugar donde un grupo pone su dinero es la señal más clara de lo que cree.

segments.src: Reading the spending patterns can offer a few clues.
segments.tr: Leer los patrones de gasto puede ofrecer algunas pistas.

segments.src: **Defense versus offense.** When a party or allied group books time in a district it usually wins, it is typically playing defense and worried about erosion there.
segments.tr: **Defensa versus ofensa.** Cuando un partido o grupo aliado reserva tiempo en un distrito que usualmente gana, típicamente está jugando a la defensiva y preocupado por el desgaste en esa zona.

segments.src: Money in territory the other side holds suggests confidence that the seat is within reach.
segments.tr: El dinero en territorio que sostiene el otro bando sugiere confianza en que el escaño está a su alcance.

segments.src: Shifts from week to week, such as a group canceling reservations in one race and adding them in another, are closely watched as a sign of internal polling.
segments.tr: Los cambios de una semana a otra, como cuando un grupo cancela reservas en una contienda y las añade en otra, se vigilan de cerca como una señal de sus encuestas internas.

segments.src: **Expanding or shrinking the battlefield.** Late reservations in a race that was not on the radar months ago suggest the map is widening.
segments.tr: **Ampliar o reducir el campo de batalla.** Las reservas de última hora en una contienda que no estaba en el radar hace meses sugieren que el mapa se está ampliando.

segments.src: Pulled reservations may mean a campaign has concluded a race is either safe or out of reach.
segments.tr: Las reservas retiradas pueden significar que una campaña ha concluido que una contienda es segura o está fuera de alcance.

segments.src: **The role of outside groups.** Super PACs and other outside organizations can raise large sums and often fill gaps that candidate committees cannot, particularly because candidates and parties have contribution limits that outside groups do not.
segments.tr: **El papel de los grupos externos.** Los super PAC y otras organizaciones externas pueden recaudar grandes sumas y, a menudo, llenar vacíos que los comités de candidatos no pueden, particularmente porque los candidatos y los partidos tienen límites de contribución que los grupos externos no tienen.

segments.src: Some of these groups disclose donors; others, such as certain nonprofits, have more limited disclosure.
segments.tr: Algunos de estos grupos divulgan sus donantes; otros, como ciertas organizaciones sin fines de lucro, tienen una divulgación más limitada.

segments.src: That is one reason transparency advocates keep a close eye on the final-month filings.
segments.tr: Esa es una de las razones por las que los defensores de la transparencia vigilan de cerca los informes del último mes.

segments.src: **Candidate fundraising strength.** In some races, one candidate has a clear fundraising advantage.
segments.tr: **Fortaleza en la recaudación de fondos de los candidatos.** En algunas contiendas, un candidato tiene una clara ventaja en la recaudación de fondos.

segments.src: In others, the candidate who is behind on money is helped by party or outside spending that narrows the gap on the air.
segments.tr: En otras, el candidato que está por detrás en dinero recibe ayuda del gasto del partido o de grupos externos que reducen la brecha en el aire.

segments.src: ## What viewers and voters should know
segments.tr: ## Lo que los espectadores y votantes deben saber

segments.src: - **Check the disclaimer.** Federal ads must state who paid for them. "Paid for by..." and "I approve this message" lines show whether an ad came from a candidate, a party committee or an outside group.
segments.tr: - **Revise el descargo de responsabilidad.** Los anuncios federales deben indicar quién los pagó. Las líneas "Pagado por..." y "Apruebo este mensaje" muestran si un anuncio provino de un candidato, un comité de partido o un grupo externo.

segments.src: - **Look up the sponsor.** The FEC database and state election offices publish campaign finance reports, and independent trackers publish ad-spending data.
segments.tr: - **Busque al patrocinador.** La base de datos de la FEC y las oficinas electorales estatales publican informes de finanzas de campaña, y rastreadores independientes publican datos de gasto publicitario.

segments.src: - **Remember that an ad is advocacy.** Campaign ads are designed to persuade. Claims about opponents are often selective, and fact-checking organizations and nonpartisan voter guides can help provide context.
segments.tr: - **Recuerde que un anuncio es una promoción.** Los anuncios de campaña están diseñados para persuadir. Las afirmaciones sobre los oponentes a menudo son selectivas, y las organizaciones de verificación de datos junto con las guías de votantes no partidistas pueden ayudar a proporcionar contexto.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote.** Rules on early voting, mail ballots and registration deadlines vary by state. Your state or local election office is the most reliable source for dates and locations.
segments.tr: - **Haga un plan para votar.** Las reglas sobre votación anticipada, papeletas por correo y plazos límite de registro varían según el estado. Su oficina electoral estatal o local es la fuente más confiable de fechas y ubicaciones.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: The late-campaign surge in political advertising is a reminder that elections are shaped by both messages and logistics.
segments.tr: El aumento de la publicidad política a finales de la campaña es un recordatorio de que las elecciones están moldeadas tanto por los mensajes como por la logística.

segments.src: Which markets get ads, which screens are targeted and which races attract outside money all reflect each side's view of where the next majority will be won or lost.
segments.tr: Qué mercados reciben anuncios, a qué pantallas se dirigen y qué contiendas atraen dinero externo reflejan la visión de cada bando sobre dónde se ganará o perderá la próxima mayoría.

segments.src: By Election Day, the spending map will say a lot about what campaigns believed was in play, even before the votes are counted.

ar.title: آلة أموال الانتخابات النصفية: أين تتدفق أموال الإعلانات الحملية في الأسابيع الأخيرة

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3 less than a month away, the last stretch of the 2026 midterm campaign is also its most expensive.
segments.tr: مع تبقي أقل من شهر على يوم الانتخابات في 3 نوفمبر، تعتبر المرحلة الأخيرة من حملة الانتخابات النصفية لعام 2026 هي الأكثر تكلفة أيضًا.

segments.src: Candidates, party committees and outside groups are all competing for a limited supply of airtime, inbox space and phone screens.
segments.tr: يتنافس المرشحون ولجان الأحزاب والمجموعات الخارجية جميعًا على إمداد محدود من أوقات البث المباشر، ومساحات صندوق الوارد، وشاشات الهواتف.

segments.src: Here is where the money tends to go in the closing weeks, and what those choices reveal about how each side reads the political map.

segments.src: ## Why the final weeks cost the most
segments.tr: ## لماذا تكلف الأسابيع الأخيرة التكلفة الأكبر

segments.src: Political advertising follows a predictable pattern.
segments.tr: تتبع الإعلانات السياسية نمطًا يمكن التنبؤ به.

segments.src: Spending ramps up as Election Day approaches, and the last few weeks are the most crowded.
segments.tr: ترتفع وتيرة الإنفاق مع اقتراب يوم الانتخابات، وتكون الأسابيع القليلة الأخيرة هي الأكثر ازدحامًا.

segments.src: There are a few reasons:
segments.tr: هناك بضعة أسباب:

segments.src: - **Voters are paying attention.** Many people tune in only when early voting begins and ballots arrive in the mail.
segments.tr: - **الناخبون يقتطعون الاهتمام.** لا يتابع العديد من الأشخاص إلا عندما يبدأ التصويت المبكر وتصل بطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد.

segments.src: - **Early voting compresses the calendar.** In many states, voting is already underway, so a message has to land before ballots are returned, not just before Election Day.
segments.tr: - **التصويت المبكر يضغط الجدول الزمني.** في العديد من الولايات، جاري التصويت بالفعل، لذا يجب أن تصل الرسالة قبل إعادة بطاقات الاقتراع، وليس فقط قبل يوم الانتخابات.

segments.src: - **Rates rise with demand.** Broadcast stations sell time in a competitive market, and prices tend to climb when many campaigns want the same slots. Federal candidates get legal protections on the rates they pay, but outside groups often pay more.
segments.tr: - **الأسعار ترتفع مع الطلب.** تبيع محطات البث الوقت في سوق تنافسي، وتتجه الأسعار إلى الارتفاع عندما ترغب العديد من الحملات في نفس الفترات الزمني. يحصل المرشحون الفيدراليون على حماية قانونية لليوم على الأسعار التي يدفعونها، لكن المجموعات الخارجية تدفع غالبًا المزيد.

segments.src: ## Where the dollars go
segments.tr: ## أين تذهب الدولارات

segments.src: ### Broadcast and cable television
segments.tr: ### التلفزيون المباشر والتلفزيون عبر الكابل

segments.src: Local broadcast TV is still the largest single line item in most competitive races.
segments.tr: لا يزال التلفزيون المحلي المباشر هو أضخم بند منفرد في معظم السباقات التنافسية.

segments.src: It reaches older, high-turnout voters efficiently, and those voters make up a large share of midterm electorates.
segments.tr: فهو يصل إلى الناخبين الأكبر سنًا والأعلى نسبة مشاركة بكفاءة، وتشكل هذه الفئة من الناخبين حصة كبيرة من الناخبين في الانتخابات النصفية.

segments.src: Costs are highest in expensive media markets, and a statewide race in a large state can require buying time in several of them.
segments.tr: تكون التكاليف أعلى في أسواق الإعلام المكلفة، وقد يتطلب سباق على مستوى الولاية في ولاية كبيرة شراء أوقات بث في العديد منها.

segments.src: ### Streaming and connected TV
segments.tr: ### البث الرقمي والتلفزيون المتصل

segments.src: Connected TV, which includes ads served on streaming services and smart-TV platforms, has become a fast-growing part of campaign budgets.
segments.tr: أصبح التلفزيون المتصل، الذي يشمل الإعلانات المقدمة على خدمات البث ومنصات التلفزيون الذكي، جزءًا سريع النمو من ميزانيات الحملات.

segments.src: Its main appeal is targeting.
segments.tr: جاذبيته الرئيسية هي الاستهداف.

segments.src: A campaign can aim at a specific geography or audience instead of paying for every viewer in a market.
segments.tr: يمكن للحملة أن تستهدف منطقة جغرافية أو جمهورًا محددًا بدلاً من الدفع مقابل كل مشاهد في السوق.

segments.src: Streaming does not replace broadcast, but many strategists now treat it as a complement, especially for reaching viewers who rarely watch live television.
segments.tr: لا يحل البث الرقمي محل البث المباشر، ولكن العديد من مخططين الاستراتيجية يتعاملون معه الآن كمكمل، خاصة للوصول إلى المشاهدين الذين نادراً ما يشاهدون التلفزيون المباشر.

segments.src: ### Digital and social
segments.tr: ### الرقمي والاجتماعي

segments.src: Online display, search, video and social ads serve several purposes.
segments.tr: تخدم العروض عبر الإنترنت والبحث والفيديو والإعلانات الاجتماعية عدة أغراض.

segments.src: Some are persuasion messages.
segments.tr: بعضها رسائل إقناع.

segments.src: Others raise money, recruit volunteers or remind supporters how and where to vote.
segments.tr: والبعض الآخر يجمع الأموال، أو يجند المتطوعين، أو يذكر المؤيدين بكيفية وأين يتم التصويت.

segments.src: Major platforms set their own rules for political ads, including disclosure requirements and, in some cases, restrictions in the final days before an election, so campaigns plan their digital calendars carefully.
segments.tr: تضع المنصات الرئيسية قواعدها الخاصة للإعلانات السياسية، بما في ذلك متطلبات الإفصاح وفي بعض الحالات القيود في الأيام الأخيرة قبل الانتخابات، لذلك تخطط الحملات لتقويمها الرقمي بعناية.

segments.src: ### Text, mail and direct outreach
segments.tr: ### الرسائل النصية والبريد والتواصل المباشر

segments.src: Texting, direct mail and phone outreach are less visible than TV but central to turnout efforts.
segments.tr: تعتبر الرسائل النصية، والبريد المباشر، والتواصل عبر الهاتف أقل وضوحًا من التلفزيون ولكنها أساسية لجهود الإقبال.

segments.src: In the closing weeks, they are used to provide polling-place information, promote early voting and urge supporters to return mail ballots.
segments.tr: في الأسابيع الأخيرة، يُستخدم هذا للتقديم معلومات حول مراكز الاقتراع، والترويج للتصويت المبكر، وحث المؤيدين على إعادة بطاقات الاقتراع بالبريد.

segments.src: Campaigns must comply with federal and state rules on messaging and consent, and responsible operations build those compliance steps into their programs.
segments.tr: يجب على الحملات الالتزام بالقواعد الفيدرالية والمحلية بشأن المراسلة والموافقة، وتضم العمليات المسؤولة خطوات الالتزام هذه في برامجها.

segments.src: ## Which races absorb the most money
segments.tr: ## ما هي السباقات التي تستوعب أكبر قدر من الأموال

segments.src: Ad money is not spread evenly.
segments.tr: أموال الإعلانات لا تتوزع بالتساوي.

segments.src: It concentrates in a small number of contests that are close enough for spending to plausibly change the outcome.
segments.tr: فهي تتركز في عدد صغير من المنافسات القريبة جدًا بحيث يمكن للإنفاق أن يغير النتيجة بشكل معقول.

segments.src: - **Competitive U.S. Senate races.** Statewide contests in battleground states draw the most spending because they cover multiple media markets and can decide control of the chamber.
segments.tr: - **سباقات مجلس الشيوخ الأمريكي التنافسية.** تجتذب المنافسات على مستوى الولاية في الولايات المتأرجحة أكبر قدر من الإنفاق لأنها تغطي أسواقًا إعلامية متعددة ويمكنها حسم السيطرة على المجلس.

segments.src: - **Governor's races.** Open seats and tight contests in large states can produce enormous ad budgets.
segments.tr: - **سباقات حكام الولايات.** المقاعد الشاغرة والمنافسات المحتدمة في الولايات الكبيرة يمكن أن تنتج ميزانيات إعلانية ضخمة.

segments.src: - **Key U.S. House districts.** Control of the House typically turns on a few dozen competitive seats. Party committees and affiliated super PACs often spend heavily in those districts, particularly in expensive markets such as the New York and Los Angeles areas, where TV costs are high.
segments.tr: - **دوائر مجلس النواب الأمريكي الرئيسية.** تعتمد السيطرة على مجلس النواب عادةً على بضع عشرات من المقاعد التنافسية. غالبًا ما تنفق لجان الأحزاب وsuper PACs التابعة لها بكثافة في تلك الدوائر، خاصة في الأسواق المكلفة مثل مناطق New York و Los Angeles، حيث تكاليف التلفزيون مرتفعة.

segments.src: - **Ballot measures.** In some states, referendums and initiatives on issues such as taxes, abortion access or election rules attract eight-figure campaigns of their own.
segments.tr: - **مبادرات الاقتراع.** في بعض الولايات، تجتذب الاستفتاءات والمبادرات الخاصة بقضايا مثل الضرائب، والحصول على الإجهاض، أو قواعد الانتخابات حملات تتجاوز قيمتها ثمانية أرقام.

segments.src: ## What the spending says about the map
segments.tr: ## ماذا يقول الإنفاق عن الخريطة

segments.src: Strategists often say that where a group puts its money is the clearest signal of what it believes.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يقول مخططو الاستراتيجية إن أين تضع المجموعة أموالها هو أوضح إشارة لما تصدقه.

segments.src: Reading the spending patterns can offer a few clues.
segments.tr: قراءة أنماط الإنفاق يمكن أن تقدم بضع أدلة.

segments.src: **Defense versus offense.** When a party or allied group books time in a district it usually wins, it is typically playing defense and worried about erosion there.
segments.tr: **الدفاع مقابل الهجوم.** عندما تحجز فرقة أو مجموعة حليفة وقتاً في دائرة تفوز بها عادةً، فإنها تلعب عادةً دور الدفاع وتقلق بشأن التآكل هناك.

segments.src: Money in territory the other side holds suggests confidence that the seat is within reach.
segments.tr: المال في أراضٍ يحتفظ بها الطرف الآخر يشير إلى الثقة في أن المقعد في المتناول.

segments.src: Shifts from week to week, such as a group canceling reservations in one race and adding them in another, are closely watched as a sign of internal polling.
segments.tr: التغيرات من أسبوع لآخر، مثل قيام مجموعة بإلغاء الحجوزات في سباق وإضافتها في سباق آخر، تحظى بمتابعة وثيقة كعلامة على استطلاعات الرأي الداخلية.

segments.src: **Expanding or shrinking the battlefield.** Late reservations in a race that was not on the radar months ago suggest the map is widening.
segments.tr: **توسيع أو تقليص ساحة المعركة.** الحجوزات المتأخرة في سباق لم يكن على الرادار قبل أشهر تشير إلى أن الخريطة تتوسع.

segments.src: Pulled reservations may mean a campaign has concluded a race is either safe or out of reach.
segments.tr: قد تعني الحجوزات المرفوعة أن الحملة استنتجت أن السباق إما آمن أو بعيد المنال.

segments.src: **The role of outside groups.** Super PACs and other outside organizations can raise large sums and often fill gaps that candidate committees cannot, particularly because candidates and parties have contribution limits that outside groups do not.
segments.tr: **دور المجموعات الخارجية.** يمكن للـ super PACs والمؤسسات الخارجية الأخرى جمع مبالغ كبيرة وغالبًا ما تسد الفجوات التي لا تستطيع لجان المرشحين سدها، خاصة لأن المرشحين والأحزاب لديهم حدود للمساهمة لا تملكها المجموعات الخارجية.

segments.src: Some of these groups disclose donors; others, such as certain nonprofits, have more limited disclosure.
segments.tr: تكشف بعض هذه المجموعات عن المتبرعين؛ والبعض الآخر، مثل بعض المنظمات غير الربحية، لديه إفصاح أكثر محدودية.

segments.src: That is one reason transparency advocates keep a close eye on the final-month filings.
segments.tr: هذا أحد الأسباب التي تجعل المدافعين عن الشفافية يراقبون عن كثب ملفات الشهر الأخير.

segments.src: **Candidate fundraising strength.** In some races, one candidate has a clear fundraising advantage.
segments.tr: **قوة جمع التبرعات للمرشح.** في بعض السباقات، يتمتع مرشح واحد بميزة واضحة في جمع التبرعات.

segments.src: In others, the candidate who is behind on money is helped by party or outside spending that narrows the gap on the air.
segments.tr: في حالات أخرى، يتم مساعدة المرشح المتأخر في المال من قبل الحزب أو الإنفاق الخارجي الذي يقلل الفجوة على الهواء.

segments.src: ## What viewers and voters should know
segments.tr: ## ما يجب أن يعرفه المشاهدون والناخبون

segments.src: - **Check the disclaimer.** Federal ads must state who paid for them. "Paid for by..." and "I approve this message" lines show whether an ad came from a candidate, a party committee or an outside group.
segments.tr: - **تحقق من إخلاء المسؤولية.** يجب أن تذكر الإعلانات الفيدرالية من دفع ثمنها. عبارات "تم الدفع بواسطة..." و "أنا أوافق على هذه الرسالة" تظهر ما إذا كان الإعلان قادمًا من مرشح، أو لجنة حزبية، أو مجموعة خارجية.

segments.src: - **Look up the sponsor.** The FEC database and state election offices publish campaign finance reports, and independent trackers publish ad-spending data.
segments.tr: - **ابحث عن الراعي.** تنشر قاعدة بيانات FEC ومكاتب الانتخابات في الولاية تقارير تمويل الحملات، وتنشر الجهات المستقلة للتتبع بيانات إنفاق الإعلانات.

segments.src: - **Remember that an ad is advocacy.** Campaign ads are designed to persuade. Claims about opponents are often selective, and fact-checking organizations and nonpartisan voter guides can help provide context.
segments.tr: - **تذكر أن الإعلان هو ترويج.** تم تصميم إعلانات الحملات للإقناع. الادعاءات حول المنافسين غالبًا ما تكون انتقائية، ويمكن لمنظمات التحقق من الحقائق وأدلة الناخبين غير الحزبية أن تساعد في توفير السياق.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote.** Rules on early voting, mail ballots and registration deadlines vary by state. Your state or local election office is the most reliable source for dates and locations.
segments.tr: - **اصنع خطة للتصويت.** تختلف القواعد الخاصة بالتصويت المبكر، وبطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد، والمواعيد النهائية للتسجيل حسب الولاية. مكتب الانتخابات المحلي أو الخاص بولايتك هو المصدر الأكثر موثوقية للتوارخ والمواقع.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.tr: تعد الزيادة الكبيرة في الإعلانات السياسية في أواخر الحملة تذكيرًا بأن الانتخابات تتشكل من خلال الرسائل والخدمات اللوجستية معًا.

segments.src: ## Why the final weeks cost the most
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les dernières semaines coûtent le plus cher

segments.src: Political advertising follows a predictable pattern.
segments.tr: La publicité politique suit un modèle prévisible.

segments.src: Spending ramps up as Election Day approaches, and the last few weeks are the most crowded.
segments.tr: Les dépenses augmentent à l'approche du jour des élections, et les dernières semaines sont les plus encombrées.

segments.src: There are a few reasons:
segments.tr: Il y a quelques raisons :

segments.src: - **Voters are paying attention.** Many people tune in only when early voting begins and ballots arrive in the mail.
segments.tr: - **Les électeurs sont attentifs.** Beaucoup de gens ne s'y intéressent que lorsque le vote anticipé commence et que les bulletins arrivent par la poste.

segments.src: - **Early voting compresses the calendar.** In many states, voting is already underway, so a message has to land before ballots are returned, not just before Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Le vote anticipé comprime le calendrier.** Dans de nombreux États, le vote est déjà en cours, donc un message doit arriver avant que les bulletins ne soient retournés, pas seulement avant le jour des élections.

segments.src: - **Rates rise with demand.** Broadcast stations sell time in a competitive market, and prices tend to climb when many campaigns want the same slots. Federal candidates get legal protections on the rates they pay, but outside groups often pay more.
segments.tr: - **Les tarifs augmentent avec la demande.** Les stations de diffusion vendent du temps sur un marché concurrentiel, et les prix ont tendance à grimper lorsque de nombreuses campagnes veulent les mêmes créneaux. Les candidats fédéraux bénéficient de protections juridiques sur les tarifs qu'ils paient, mais les groupes extérieurs paient souvent plus cher.

segments.src: ## Where the dollars go
segments.tr: ## Où va l'argent

segments.src: ### Broadcast and cable television
segments.tr: ### Télévision hertzienne et par câble

segments.src: Local broadcast TV is still the largest single line item in most competitive races.
segments.tr: La télévision locale reste le poste de dépense unique le plus important dans la plupart des courses compétitives.

segments.src: It reaches older, high-turnout voters efficiently, and those voters make up a large share of midterm electorates.
segments.tr: Elle atteint efficacement les électeurs plus âgés à fort taux de participation, et ces électeurs constituent une grande part des électorats de mi-mandat.

segments.src: Costs are highest in expensive media markets, and a statewide race in a large state can require buying time in several of them.
segments.tr: Les coûts sont les plus élevés sur les marchés médiatiques coûteux, et une course à l'échelle de l'État dans un grand État peut nécessiter d'acheter du temps sur plusieurs d'entre eux.

segments.src: ### Streaming and connected TV
segments.tr: ### Streaming et télévision connectée

segments.src: Connected TV, which includes ads served on streaming services and smart-TV platforms, has become a fast-growing part of campaign budgets.
segments.tr: La télévision connectée, qui comprend les publicités diffusées sur les services de streaming et les plateformes de télévision intelligente, est devenue une partie à croissance rapide des budgets de campagne.

segments.src: Its main appeal is targeting.
segments.tr: Son principal attrait est le ciblage.

segments.src: A campaign can aim at a specific geography or audience instead of paying for every viewer in a market.
segments.tr: Une campagne peut viser une zone géographique ou un public spécifique au lieu de payer pour chaque spectateur sur un marché.

segments.src: Streaming does not replace broadcast, but many strategists now treat it as a complement, especially for reaching viewers who rarely watch live television.
segments.tr: Le streaming ne remplace pas la diffusion, mais de nombreux stratèges le traitent désormais comme un complément, en particulier pour atteindre les téléspectateurs qui regardent rarement la télévision en direct.

segments.src: ### Digital and social
segments.tr: ### Numérique et réseaux sociaux

segments.src: Online display, search, video and social ads serve several purposes.
segments.tr: Les publicités en ligne, sur les moteurs de recherche, en vidéo et sur les réseaux sociaux servent plusieurs objectifs.

segments.src: Some are persuasion messages.
segments.tr: Certaines sont des messages de persuasion.

segments.src: Others raise money, recruit volunteers or remind supporters how and where to vote.
segments.tr: D'autres permettent de collecter des fonds, de recruter des bénévoles ou de rappeler aux partisans comment et où voter.

segments.src: Major platforms set their own rules for political ads, including disclosure requirements and, in some cases, restrictions in the final days before an election, so campaigns plan their digital calendars carefully.
segments.tr: Les grandes plateformes fixent leurs propres règles pour les publicités politiques, y compris les exigences de divulgation et, dans certains cas, des restrictions dans les derniers jours avant une élection, de sorte que les campagnes planifient soigneusement leurs calendriers numériques.

segments.src: ### Text, mail and direct outreach
segments.tr: ### SMS, courrier et démarchage direct

segments.src: Texting, direct mail and phone outreach are less visible than TV but central to turnout efforts.
segments.tr: Les SMS, le publipostage et le démarchage téléphonique sont moins visibles que la télévision mais sont essentiels aux efforts de mobilisation.

segments.src: In the closing weeks, they are used to provide polling-place information, promote early voting and urge supporters to return mail ballots.
segments.tr: Dans les dernières semaines, ils sont utilisés pour fournir des informations sur les bureaux de vote, promouvoir le vote anticipé et inciter les partisans à renvoyer leurs bulletins de vote par correspondance.

segments.src: Campaigns must comply with federal and state rules on messaging and consent, and responsible operations build those compliance steps into their programs.
segments.tr: Les campagnes doivent se conformer aux règles fédérales et étatiques sur la messagerie et le consentement, et les opérations responsables intègrent ces étapes de conformité dans leurs programmes.

segments.src: ## Which races absorb the most money
segments.tr: ## Quelles courses absorbent le plus d'argent

segments.src: Ad money is not spread evenly.
segments.tr: L'argent publicitaire n'est pas réparti uniformément.

segments.src: It concentrates in a small number of contests that are close enough for spending to plausibly change the outcome.
segments.tr: Il se concentre sur un petit nombre de scrutins qui sont suffisamment serrés pour que les dépenses puissent plausiblement changer le résultat.

segments.src: - **Competitive U.S. Senate races.** Statewide contests in battleground states draw the most spending because they cover multiple media markets and can decide control of the chamber.
segments.tr: - **Courses compétitives au Sénat américain.** Les scrutins à l'échelle de l'État dans les États pivots attirent le plus de dépenses car ils couvrent plusieurs marchés médiatiques et peuvent décider du contrôle de la chambre.

segments.src: - **Governor's races.** Open seats and tight contests in large states can produce enormous ad budgets.
segments.tr: - **Courses au poste de gouverneur.** Les sièges vacants et les scrutins serrés dans les grands États peuvent générer d'énormes budgets publicitaires.

segments.src: - **Key U.S. House districts.** Control of the House typically turns on a few dozen competitive seats. Party committees and affiliated super PACs often spend heavily in those districts, particularly in expensive markets such as the New York and Los Angeles areas, where TV costs are high.
segments.tr: - **Districts clés de la Chambre des représentants américaine.** Le contrôle de la Chambre dépend généralement de quelques douzaines de sièges compétitifs. Les comités de parti et les super PAC affiliés dépensent souvent massivement dans ces districts, en particulier sur des marchés coûteux tels que les zones de New York et de Los Angeles, où les coûts de la télévision sont élevés.

segments.src: - **Ballot measures.** In some states, referendums and initiatives on issues such as taxes, abortion access or election rules attract eight-figure campaigns of their own.
segments.tr: - **Référendums.** Dans certains États, les référendums et les initiatives sur des questions telles que les impôts, l'accès à l'avortement ou les règles électorales attirent eux-mêmes des campagnes à huit chiffres.

segments.src: ## What the spending says about the map
segments.tr: ## Ce que les dépenses disent de la carte

segments.src: Strategists often say that where a group puts its money is the clearest signal of what it believes.
segments.tr: Les stratèges disent souvent que l'endroit où un groupe place son argent est le signal le plus clair de ce qu'il croit.

segments.src: Reading the spending patterns can offer a few clues.
segments.tr: Lire les modèles de dépenses peut offrir quelques indices.

segments.src: **Defense versus offense.** When a party or allied group books time in a district it usually wins, it is typically playing defense and worried about erosion there.
segments.tr: **Défense contre attaque.** Lorsqu'un parti ou un groupe allié réserve du temps dans un district qu'il gagne habituellement, il joue généralement la défense et s'inquiète de l'érosion à cet endroit.

segments.src: Money in territory the other side holds suggests confidence that the seat is within reach.
segments.tr: L'argent sur un territoire détenu par l'autre camp suggère la confiance que le siège est à portée de main.

segments.src: Shifts from week to week, such as a group canceling reservations in one race and adding them in another, are closely watched as a sign of internal polling.
segments.tr: Les changements d'une semaine à l'autre, comme un groupe annulant des réservations dans une course et en ajoutant dans une autre, sont étroitement surveillés comme un signe de sondages internes.

segments.src: **Expanding or shrinking the battlefield.** Late reservations in a race that was not on the radar months ago suggest the map is widening.
segments.tr: **Élargir ou réduire le champ de bataille.** Les réservations tardives dans une course qui n'était pas sur le radar il y a quelques mois suggèrent que la carte s'élargit.

segments.src: Pulled reservations may mean a campaign has concluded a race is either safe or out of reach.
segments.tr: Les réservations annulées peuvent signifier qu'une campagne a conclu qu'une course est soit sûre, soit hors de portée.

segments.src: **The role of outside groups.** Super PACs and other outside organizations can raise large sums and often fill gaps that candidate committees cannot, particularly because candidates and parties have contribution limits that outside groups do not.
segments.tr: **Le rôle des groupes extérieurs.** Les super PAC et autres organisations extérieures peuvent lever des sommes importantes et combler souvent des lacunes que les comités de candidats ne peuvent pas combler, notamment parce que les candidats et les partis ont des limites de contribution que les groupes extérieurs n'ont pas.

segments.src: Some of these groups disclose donors; others, such as certain nonprofits, have more limited disclosure.
segments.tr: Certains de ces groupes divulguent leurs donateurs ; d'autres, comme certaines organisations à but non lucratif, ont une divulgation plus limitée.

segments.src: That is one reason transparency advocates keep a close eye on the final-month filings.
segments.tr: C'est une raison pour laquelle les défenseurs de la transparence surveillent de près les dépôts du dernier mois.

segments.src: **Candidate fundraising strength.** In some races, one candidate has a clear fundraising advantage.
segments.tr: **Force de collecte de fonds des candidats.** Dans certaines courses, un candidat a un net avantage en matière de collecte de fonds.

segments.src: In others, the candidate who is behind on money is helped by party or outside spending that narrows the gap on the air.
segments.tr: Dans d'autres, le candidat qui est en retard sur l'argent est aidé par les dépenses du parti ou des groupes extérieurs qui réduisent l'écart sur les ondes.

segments.src: ## What viewers and voters should know
segments.tr: ## Ce que les téléspectateurs et les électeurs doivent savoir

segments.src: - **Check the disclaimer.** Federal ads must state who paid for them. "Paid for by..." and "I approve this message" lines show whether an ad came from a candidate, a party committee or an outside group.
segments.tr: - **Vérifiez la clause de non-responsabilité.** Les publicités fédérales doivent indiquer qui les a payées. Les lignes "Payé par..." et "J'approuve ce message" montrent si une publicité provient d'un candidat, d'un comité de parti ou d'un groupe extérieur.

segments.src: - **Look up the sponsor.** The FEC database and state election offices publish campaign finance reports, and independent trackers publish ad-spending data.
segments.tr: - **Recherchez le sponsor.** La base de données de la FEC et les bureaux électoraux des États publient des rapports sur le financement des campagnes, et des trackers indépendants publient des données sur les dépenses publicitaires.

segments.src: - **Remember that an ad is advocacy.** Campaign ads are designed to persuade. Claims about opponents are often selective, and fact-checking organizations and nonpartisan voter guides can help provide context.
segments.tr: - **N'oubliez pas qu'une publicité est un plaidoyer.** Les publicités de campagne sont conçues pour persuader. Les affirmations sur les opposants sont souvent sélectives, et les organisations de vérification des faits ainsi que les guides électoraux non partisans peuvent aider à fournir un contexte.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote.** Rules on early voting, mail ballots and registration deadlines vary by state. Your state or local election office is the most reliable source for dates and locations.
segments.tr: - **Prévoyez de voter.** Les règles sur le vote anticipé, les bulletins de vote par correspondance et les dates limites d'inscription varient selon l'État. Votre bureau électoral local ou d'État est la source la plus fiable pour les dates et les lieux.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: The late-campaign surge in political advertising is a reminder that elections are shaped by both messages and logistics.
segments.tr: La poussée de fin de campagne dans la publicité politique rappelle que les élections sont façonnées à la fois par les messages et la logistique.

segments.src: Which markets get ads, which screens are targeted and which races attract outside money all reflect each side's view of where the next majority will be won or lost.
segments.tr: Quels marchés reçoivent des publicités, quels écrans sont ciblés et quelles courses attirent l'argent extérieur reflètent tous la vision de chaque camp sur l'endroit où la prochaine majorité sera gagnée ou perdue.

segments.src: By Election Day, the spending map will say a lot about what campaigns believed was in play, even before the votes are counted.
segments.tr: D'ici le jour des élections, la carte des dépenses en dira long sur ce que les campagnes croyaient être en jeu, avant même que les votes ne soient comptés.
