segments.src: - **Check the disclaimer.** Federal ads must state who paid for them. "Paid for by..." and "I approve this message" lines show whether an ad came from a candidate, a party committee or an outside group.
segments.tr: - **Verifique a isenção de responsabilidade.** Anúncios federais devem declarar quem pagou por eles. As linhas "Pago por..." e "Eu aprovo esta mensagem" mostram se um anúncio veio de um candidato, de um comitê partidário ou de um grupo externo.

segments.src: - **Look up the sponsor.** The FEC database and state election offices publish campaign finance reports, and independent trackers publish ad-spending data.
segments.tr: - **Procure o patrocinador.** O banco de dados da FEC e os escritórios eleitorais estaduais publicam relatórios de financiamento de campanha, e rastreadores independentes publicam dados de gastos com publicidade.

segments.src: - **Remember that an ad is advocacy.** Campaign ads are designed to persuade. Claims about opponents are often selective, and fact-checking organizations and nonpartisan voter guides can help provide context.
segments.tr: - **Lembre-se de que um anúncio é defesa de uma causa.** Anúncios de campanha são projetados para persuadir. Alegações sobre oponentes são frequentemente seletivas, e organizações de verificação de fatos e guias eleitorais apartidários podem ajudar a fornecer contexto.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote.** Rules on early voting, mail ballots and registration deadlines vary by state. Your state or local election office is the most reliable source for dates and locations.
segments.tr: - **Faça um plano para votar.** As regras sobre votação antecipada, cédulas pelo correio e prazos de registro variam de acordo com o estado. Seu escritório eleitoral estadual ou local é a fonte mais confiável para datas e locais.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O ponto principal

segments.src: The late-campaign surge in political advertising is a reminder that elections are shaped by both messages and logistics.
segments.tr: O aumento da publicidade política no final da campanha é um lembrete de que as eleições são moldadas tanto por mensagens quanto por logística.

segments.src: Which markets get ads, which screens are targeted and which races attract outside money all reflect each side's view of where the next majority will be won or lost.
segments.tr: Quais mercados recebem anúncios, quais telas são visadas e quais disputas atraem dinheiro externo, tudo reflete a visão de cada lado sobre onde a próxima maioria será ganha ou perdida.

segments.src: By Election Day, the spending map will say a lot about what campaigns believed was in play, even before the votes are counted.
segments.tr: Até o Dia da Eleição, o mapa de gastos dirá muito sobre o que as campanhas acreditavam estar em jogo, mesmo antes de os votos serem contados.

in.title: Mesin Uang Pemilu Sela: Ke Mana Dana Iklan Kampanye Mengalir di Minggu-Minggu Terakhir

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3 less than a month away, the last stretch of the 2026 midterm campaign is also its most expensive.
segments.tr: Dengan Hari Pemilihan pada 3 November yang tinggal kurang dari sebulan lagi, masa-masa terakhir kampanye pemilu sela 2026 juga menjadi masa yang paling mahal.

segments.src: Candidates, party committees and outside groups are all competing for a limited supply of airtime, inbox space and phone screens.
segments.tr: Para kandidat, komite partai, dan kelompok luar semuanya bersaing untuk mendapatkan jatah waktu tayang, ruang kotak masuk, dan layar ponsel yang terbatas.

segments.src: Here is where the money tends to go in the closing weeks, and what those choices reveal about how each side reads the political map.
segments.tr: Berikut adalah ke mana uang cenderung mengalir di minggu-minggu penutupan, dan apa yang diungkapkan oleh pilihan-pilihan tersebut tentang bagaimana masing-masing pihak membaca peta politik.

segments.src: *Note: This article is a general explainer.
segments.tr: *Catatan: Artikel ini adalah penjelasan umum.

segments.src: Spending totals change daily, so check ad-tracking firms and the Federal Election Commission (FEC) for current figures.*
segments.tr: Total pengeluaran berubah setiap hari, jadi periksa perusahaan pelacak iklan dan Komisi Pemilihan Federal (FEC) untuk angka terkini.*

segments.src: ## Why the final weeks cost the most
segments.tr: ## Mengapa minggu-minggu terakhir memakan biaya paling besar

segments.src: Political advertising follows a predictable pattern.
segments.tr: Iklan politik mengikuti pola yang dapat diprediksi.

segments.src: Spending ramps up as Election Day approaches, and the last few weeks are the most crowded.
segments.tr: Pengeluaran meningkat seiring mendekatnya Hari Pemilihan, dan beberapa minggu terakhir adalah yang paling padat.

segments.src: There are a few reasons:
segments.tr: Ada beberapa alasan:

segments.src: - **Voters are paying attention.** Many people tune in only when early voting begins and ballots arrive in the mail.
segments.tr: - **Pemilih mulai memperhatikan.** Banyak orang baru menyimak ketika pemungutan suara awal dimulai dan surat suara tiba di pos.

segments.src: - **Early voting compresses the calendar.** In many states, voting is already underway, so a message has to land before ballots are returned, not just before Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Pemungutan suara awal memadatkan kalender.** Di banyak negara bagian, pemungutan suara sudah berlangsung, jadi pesan harus sampai sebelum surat suara dikembalikan, bukan hanya sebelum Hari Pemilihan.

segments.src: - **Rates rise with demand.** Broadcast stations sell time in a competitive market, and prices tend to climb when many campaigns want the same slots. Federal candidates get legal protections on the rates they pay, but outside groups often pay more.
segments.tr: - **Tarif naik seiring permintaan.** Stasiun siaran menjual waktu di pasar yang kompetitif, dan harga cenderung naik ketika banyak kampanye menginginkan slot yang sama. Kandidat federal mendapatkan perlindungan hukum atas tarif yang mereka bayar, tetapi kelompok luar sering kali membayar lebih.

segments.src: ## Where the dollars go
segments.tr: ## Ke mana uang mengalir

segments.src: ### Broadcast and cable television
segments.tr: ### Televisi siaran dan kabel

segments.src: Local broadcast TV is still the largest single line item in most competitive races.
segments.tr: TV siaran lokal masih menjadi pos pengeluaran tunggal terbesar dalam sebagian besar pemilihan yang kompetitif.

segments.src: It reaches older, high-turnout voters efficiently, and those voters make up a large share of midterm electorates.
segments.tr: Media ini menjangkau pemilih yang lebih tua dengan tingkat partisipasi tinggi secara efisien, dan para pemilih tersebut mencakup sebagian besar dari pemilih pemilu sela.

segments.src: Costs are highest in expensive media markets, and a statewide race in a large state can require buying time in several of them.
segments.tr: Biaya paling tinggi ada di pasar media yang mahal, dan pemilihan tingkat negara bagian di negara bagian yang besar mungkin memerlukan pembelian waktu di beberapa pasar tersebut.

segments.src: ### Streaming and connected TV
segments.tr: ### Streaming dan TV terhubung

segments.src: Connected TV, which includes ads served on streaming services and smart-TV platforms, has become a fast-growing part of campaign budgets.
segments.tr: TV terhubung, yang mencakup iklan yang ditayangkan di layanan streaming dan platform smart-TV, telah menjadi bagian yang tumbuh cepat dalam anggaran kampanye.

segments.src: Its main appeal is targeting.
segments.tr: Daya tarik utamanya adalah penargetan.

segments.src: A campaign can aim at a specific geography or audience instead of paying for every viewer in a market.
segments.tr: Kampanye dapat membidik geografi atau audiens tertentu alih-alih membayar untuk setiap penonton di suatu pasar.

segments.src: Streaming does not replace broadcast, but many strategists now treat it as a complement, especially for reaching viewers who rarely watch live television.
segments.tr: Streaming tidak menggantikan siaran, tetapi banyak ahli strategi sekarang menganggapnya sebagai pelengkap, terutama untuk menjangkau pemirsa yang jarang menonton televisi langsung.

segments.src: ### Digital and social
segments.tr: ### Digital dan sosial

segments.src: Online display, search, video and social ads serve several purposes.
segments.tr: Iklan tampilan online, pencarian, video, dan sosial melayani beberapa tujuan.

segments.src: Some are persuasion messages.
segments.tr: Beberapa adalah pesan persuasi.

segments.src: Others raise money, recruit volunteers or remind supporters how and where to vote.
segments.tr: Yang lain menggalang dana, merekrut sukarelawan, atau mengingatkan pendukung tentang cara dan tempat untuk memilih.

segments.src: Major platforms set their own rules for political ads, including disclosure requirements and, in some cases, restrictions in the final days before an election, so campaigns plan their digital calendars carefully.
segments.tr: Platform utama menetapkan aturan mereka sendiri untuk iklan politik, termasuk persyaratan pengungkapan dan, dalam beberapa kasus, pembatasan di hari-hari terakhir sebelum pemilihan, jadi kampanye merencanakan kalender digital mereka dengan cermat.

segments.src: ### Text, mail and direct outreach
segments.tr: ### Teks, surat, dan penjangkauan langsung

segments.src: Texting, direct mail and phone outreach are less visible than TV but central to turnout efforts.
segments.tr: Pesan teks, surat langsung, dan penjangkauan telepon kurang terlihat dibandingkan TV tetapi sangat penting untuk upaya partisipasi pemilih.

segments.src: In the closing weeks, they are used to provide polling-place information, promote early voting and urge supporters to return mail ballots.
segments.tr: Di minggu-minggu penutupan, sarana ini digunakan untuk memberikan informasi tempat pemungutan suara, mempromosikan pemungutan suara awal, dan mendesak pendukung untuk mengembalikan surat suara.

segments.src: Campaigns must comply with federal and state rules on messaging and consent, and responsible operations build those compliance steps into their programs.
segments.tr: Kampanye harus mematuhi aturan federal dan negara bagian mengenai pesan dan persetujuan, dan operasi yang bertanggung jawab membangun langkah-langkah kepatuhan tersebut ke dalam program mereka.

segments.src: ## Which races absorb the most money
segments.tr: ## Pemilihan mana yang menyerap paling banyak uang

segments.src: Ad money is not spread evenly.
segments.tr: Uang iklan tidak tersebar merata.

segments.src: It concentrates in a small number of contests that are close enough for spending to plausibly change the outcome.
segments.tr: Uang tersebut terkonsentrasi pada sejumlah kecil kontes yang cukup ketat sehingga pengeluaran dapat secara masuk akal mengubah hasil.

segments.src: - **Competitive U.S. Senate races.** Statewide contests in battleground states draw the most spending because they cover multiple media markets and can decide control of the chamber.
segments.tr: - **Pemilihan Senat AS yang kompetitif.** Kontes tingkat negara bagian di negara bagian yang menjadi medan pertempuran menarik pengeluaran paling banyak karena mencakup beberapa pasar media dan dapat menentukan kendali atas majelis tersebut.

segments.src: - **Governor's races.** Open seats and tight contests in large states can produce enormous ad budgets.
segments.tr: - **Pemilihan Gubernur.** Kursi yang kosong dan kontes ketat di negara bagian besar dapat menghasilkan anggaran iklan yang sangat besar.

segments.src: - **Key U.S. House districts.** Control of the House typically turns on a few dozen competitive seats. Party committees and affiliated super PACs often spend heavily in those districts, particularly in expensive markets such as the New York and Los Angeles areas, where TV costs are high.
segments.tr: - **Distrik DPR AS yang utama.** Kendali atas DPR biasanya bergantung pada beberapa lusin kursi yang kompetitif. Komite partai dan super PAC yang berafiliasi sering menghabiskan banyak uang di distrik-distrik tersebut, terutama di pasar yang mahal seperti wilayah New York dan Los Angeles, di mana biaya TV tinggi.

segments.src: - **Ballot measures.** In some states, referendums and initiatives on issues such as taxes, abortion access or election rules attract eight-figure campaigns of their own.
segments.tr: - **Tindakan pemungutan suara.** Di beberapa negara bagian, referendum dan inisiatif mengenai isu-isu seperti pajak, akses aborsi, atau aturan pemilihan menarik kampanye bernilai delapan digit.

segments.src: ## What the spending says about the map
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dikatakan pengeluaran tentang peta politik

segments.src: Strategists often say that where a group puts its money is the clearest signal of what it believes.
segments.tr: Ahli strategi sering mengatakan bahwa ke mana suatu kelompok menempatkan uangnya adalah sinyal paling jelas tentang apa yang mereka yakini.

segments.src: Reading the spending patterns can offer a few clues.
segments.tr: Membaca pola pengeluaran dapat memberikan beberapa petunjuk.

segments.src: **Defense versus offense.** When a party or allied group books time in a district it usually wins, it is typically playing defense and worried about erosion there.
segments.tr: **Pertahanan versus serangan.** Ketika sebuah partai atau kelompok sekutu memesan waktu di distrik yang biasanya mereka menangkan, mereka biasanya bermain bertahan dan khawatir tentang erosi di sana.

segments.src: Money in territory the other side holds suggests confidence that the seat is within reach.
segments.tr: Uang di wilayah yang dikuasai pihak lain menunjukkan keyakinan bahwa kursi tersebut dapat diraih.

segments.src: Shifts from week to week, such as a group canceling reservations in one race and adding them in another, are closely watched as a sign of internal polling.
segments.tr: Pergeseran dari minggu ke minggu, seperti kelompok yang membatalkan reservasi dalam satu pemilihan dan menambahkannya di pemilihan lain, diawasi dengan ketat sebagai tanda jajak pendapat internal.

segments.src: **Expanding or shrinking the battlefield.** Late reservations in a race that was not on the radar months ago suggest the map is widening.
segments.tr: **Memperluas atau mempersempit medan pertempuran.** Reservasi terlambat dalam pemilihan yang tidak ada dalam radar beberapa bulan lalu menunjukkan peta sedang melebar.

segments.src: Pulled reservations may mean a campaign has concluded a race is either safe or out of reach.
segments.tr: Reservasi yang ditarik mungkin berarti kampanye telah menyimpulkan bahwa suatu pemilihan sudah aman atau di luar jangkauan.

segments.src: **The role of outside groups.** Super PACs and other outside organizations can raise large sums and often fill gaps that candidate committees cannot, particularly because candidates and parties have contribution limits that outside groups do not.
segments.tr: **Peran kelompok luar.** Super PAC dan organisasi luar lainnya dapat mengumpulkan dana besar dan sering kali mengisi celah yang tidak bisa diisi oleh komite kandidat, terutama karena kandidat dan partai memiliki batas kontribusi yang tidak dimiliki kelompok luar.

segments.src: Some of these groups disclose donors; others, such as certain nonprofits, have more limited disclosure.
segments.tr: Beberapa dari kelompok ini mengungkapkan donor; yang lain, seperti organisasi nirlaba tertentu, memiliki pengungkapan yang lebih terbatas.

segments.src: That is one reason transparency advocates keep a close eye on the final-month filings.
segments.tr: Itulah salah satu alasan mengapa advokat transparansi terus memantau pengajuan laporan bulan terakhir.

segments.src: **Candidate fundraising strength.** In some races, one candidate has a clear fundraising advantage.
segments.tr: **Kekuatan penggalangan dana kandidat.** Dalam beberapa pemilihan, satu kandidat memiliki keunggulan penggalangan dana yang jelas.

segments.src: In others, the candidate who is behind on money is helped by party or outside spending that narrows the gap on the air.
segments.tr: Dalam pemilihan lain, kandidat yang tertinggal dalam hal uang dibantu oleh pengeluaran partai atau pihak luar yang mempersempit kesenjangan di media.

segments.src: ## What viewers and voters should know
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus diketahui pemirsa dan pemilih

segments.src: - **Check the disclaimer.** Federal ads must state who paid for them. "Paid for by..." and "I approve this message" lines show whether an ad came from a candidate, a party committee or an outside group.
segments.tr: - **Periksa penafian.** Iklan federal harus menyatakan siapa yang membayarnya. Baris "Dibayar oleh..." dan "Saya menyetujui pesan ini" menunjukkan apakah iklan berasal dari kandidat, komite partai, atau kelompok luar.

segments.src: - **Look up the sponsor.** The FEC database and state election offices publish campaign finance reports, and independent trackers publish ad-spending data.
segments.tr: - **Cari sponsornya.** Basis data FEC dan kantor pemilihan negara bagian menerbitkan laporan keuangan kampanye, dan pelacak independen menerbitkan data pengeluaran iklan.

segments.src: - **Remember that an ad is advocacy.** Campaign ads are designed to persuade. Claims about opponents are often selective, and fact-checking organizations and nonpartisan voter guides can help provide context.
segments.tr: - **Ingat bahwa iklan adalah advokasi.** Iklan kampanye dirancang untuk membujuk. Klaim tentang lawan sering kali selektif, dan organisasi pemeriksa fakta serta panduan pemilih nonpartisan dapat membantu memberikan konteks.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote.** Rules on early voting, mail ballots and registration deadlines vary by state. Your state or local election office is the most reliable source for dates and locations.
segments.tr: - **Buat rencana untuk memilih.** Aturan tentang pemungutan suara awal, surat suara, dan tenggat waktu pendaftaran bervariasi menurut negara bagian. Kantor pemilihan negara bagian atau lokal Anda adalah sumber yang paling dapat diandalkan untuk tanggal dan lokasi.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: The late-campaign surge in political advertising is a reminder that elections are shaped by both messages and logistics.
segments.tr: Lonjakan iklan politik di akhir kampanye adalah pengingat bahwa pemilihan dibentuk oleh pesan dan logistik.

segments.src: Which markets get ads, which screens are targeted and which races attract outside money all reflect each side's view of where the next majority will be won or lost.
segments.tr: Pasar mana yang mendapatkan iklan, layar mana yang ditargetkan, dan pemilihan mana yang menarik uang dari luar, semuanya mencerminkan pandangan masing-masing pihak tentang di mana mayoritas berikutnya akan dimenangkan atau dikalahkan.

segments.src: By Election Day, the spending map will say a lot about what campaigns believed was in play, even before the votes are counted.
segments.tr: Menjelang Hari Pemilihan, peta pengeluaran akan banyak bercerita tentang apa yang diyakini oleh kampanye, bahkan sebelum suara dihitung.

segments.src: ### Text, mail and direct outreach
segments.tr: ### テキストメッセージ、郵便、直接的な働きかけ

segments.src: Texting, direct mail and phone outreach are less visible than TV but central to turnout efforts.
segments.tr: テキストメッセージ、ダイレクトメール、電話による働きかけは、テレビほど目立ちませんが、投票率向上の取り組みにおいて中心的な役割を果たします。

segments.src: In the closing weeks, they are used to provide polling-place information, promote early voting and urge supporters to return mail ballots.
segments.tr: 最終盤には、投票所の情報の提供、期日前投票の促進、支持者への郵便投票用紙の返送の呼びかけなどに使用されます。

segments.src: Campaigns must comply with federal and state rules on messaging and consent, and responsible operations build those compliance steps into their programs.
segments.tr: 陣営はメッセージ送信や同意に関する連邦および州の規則を遵守しなければならず、責任ある運営を行う陣営は、そうしたコンプライアンスの手順をプログラムに組み込んでいます。

segments.src: ## Which races absorb the most money
segments.tr: ## どの選挙戦に最も資金が集中するのか

segments.src: Ad money is not spread evenly.
segments.tr: 広告費は均等に分配されるわけではありません。

segments.src: It concentrates in a small number of contests that are close enough for spending to plausibly change the outcome.
segments.tr: 支出によって結果が変わる可能性があるほど接戦となっている少数の選挙戦に集中します。

segments.src: - **Competitive U.S. Senate races.** Statewide contests in battleground states draw the most spending because they cover multiple media markets and can decide control of the chamber.
segments.tr: - **激戦の米上院選。** 激戦州での州全域を対象とした選挙戦は、複数のメディア市場をカバーし、議会の支配権を左右する可能性があるため、最も多くの支出を集めます。

segments.src: - **Governor's races.** Open seats and tight contests in large states can produce enormous ad budgets.
segments.tr: - **知事選。** 大規模な州での空席や接戦は、莫大な広告予算を生み出す可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Key U.S. House districts.** Control of the House typically turns on a few dozen competitive seats. Party committees and affiliated super PACs often spend heavily in those districts, particularly in expensive markets such as the New York and Los Angeles areas, where TV costs are high.
segments.tr: - **重要な米下院選挙区。** 下院の支配権は通常、数十の激戦区によって決まります。政党委員会や関連するスーパーPACは、特にニューヨークやロサンゼルス地域のようなテレビ費用が高い高額な市場において、それらの選挙区に多額の支出を行うことがよくあります。

segments.src: - **Ballot measures.** In some states, referendums and initiatives on issues such as taxes, abortion access or election rules attract eight-figure campaigns of their own.
segments.tr: - **住民投票。** 一部の州では、税金、中絶へのアクセス、選挙ルールなどの問題に関する住民投票やイニシアチブが、それ自体で数千万ドル規模のキャンペーンを引き起こします。

segments.src: ## What the spending says about the map
segments.tr: ## 支出が示す情勢マップ

segments.src: Strategists often say that where a group puts its money is the clearest signal of what it believes.
segments.tr: 戦略家はよく、団体がどこに資金を投入するかが、その団体が何を信じているかを示す最も明確なシグナルだと言います。

segments.src: Reading the spending patterns can offer a few clues.
segments.tr: 支出パターンを読み解くことで、いくつかの手がかりが得られます。

segments.src: **Defense versus offense.** When a party or allied group books time in a district it usually wins, it is typically playing defense and worried about erosion there.
segments.tr: **守りと攻め。** 政党や関連団体が通常勝利する選挙区で放送枠を確保する場合、それは通常、守りの姿勢であり、そこでの支持基盤の浸食を懸念していることを意味します。

segments.src: Money in territory the other side holds suggests confidence that the seat is within reach.
segments.tr: 相手側が保持している地域への資金投入は、その議席が射程圏内にあるという自信を示唆しています。

segments.src: Shifts from week to week, such as a group canceling reservations in one race and adding them in another, are closely watched as a sign of internal polling.
segments.tr: ある選挙戦での予約をキャンセルし、別の選挙戦で追加するといった週ごとの変化は、内部世論調査の兆候として注視されています。

segments.src: **Expanding or shrinking the battlefield.** Late reservations in a race that was not on the radar months ago suggest the map is widening.
segments.tr: **戦場の拡大または縮小。** 数ヶ月前には注目されていなかった選挙戦での遅い時期の予約は、戦場が拡大していることを示唆しています。

segments.src: Pulled reservations may mean a campaign has concluded a race is either safe or out of reach.
segments.tr: 予約の取り消しは、陣営がその選挙戦を「安全」または「到達不可能」と判断したことを意味する可能性があります。

segments.src: **The role of outside groups.** Super PACs and other outside organizations can raise large sums and often fill gaps that candidate committees cannot, particularly because candidates and parties have contribution limits that outside groups do not.
segments.tr: **外部団体の役割。** スーパーPACやその他の外部組織は多額の資金を集めることができ、候補者委員会ができない穴を埋めることがよくあります。特に、候補者や政党には寄付制限がありますが、外部団体にはそれがないためです。

segments.src: Some of these groups disclose donors; others, such as certain nonprofits, have more limited disclosure.
segments.tr: これらの団体の中には寄付者を公開するものもあれば、特定の非営利団体のように開示がより限定的なものもあります。

segments.src: That is one reason transparency advocates keep a close eye on the final-month filings.
segments.tr: それが、透明性を求める活動家が最後の1ヶ月の報告書を注視する理由の一つです。

segments.src: **Candidate fundraising strength.** In some races, one candidate has a clear fundraising advantage.
segments.tr: **候補者の資金調達力。** 一部の選挙戦では、一方の候補者が資金調達で明確な優位に立っています。

segments.src: In others, the candidate who is behind on money is helped by party or outside spending that narrows the gap on the air.
segments.tr: また別の選挙戦では、資金面で遅れている候補者が、政党や外部からの支出によって助けられ、放送枠での差を縮めています。

segments.src: ## What viewers and voters should know
segments.tr: ## 視聴者と有権者が知っておくべきこと

segments.src: - **Check the disclaimer.** Federal ads must state who paid for them. "Paid for by..." and "I approve this message" lines show whether an ad came from a candidate, a party committee or an outside group.
segments.tr: - **免責事項を確認する。** 連邦選挙関連の広告には、誰が支払ったかを明記しなければなりません。「Paid for by...（～が支払いました）」や「I approve this message（私はこのメッセージを承認します）」という文言は、広告が候補者、政党委員会、外部団体のいずれから出たものかを示しています。

segments.src: - **Look up the sponsor.** The FEC database and state election offices publish campaign finance reports, and independent trackers publish ad-spending data.
segments.tr: - **スポンサーを調べる。** FECのデータベースや州の選挙管理事務所は選挙資金報告書を公開しており、独立した追跡機関が広告支出データを公開しています。

segments.src: - **Remember that an ad is advocacy.** Campaign ads are designed to persuade. Claims about opponents are often selective, and fact-checking organizations and nonpartisan voter guides can help provide context.
segments.tr: - **広告は主張であることを忘れない。** 選挙広告は説得を目的として設計されています。対立候補に関する主張は選択的であることが多く、ファクトチェック団体や超党派の有権者ガイドが文脈を理解する助けになります。

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote.** Rules on early voting, mail ballots and registration deadlines vary by state. Your state or local election office is the most reliable source for dates and locations.
segments.tr: - **投票計画を立てる。** 期日前投票、郵便投票、登録期限に関するルールは州によって異なります。州や地域の選挙管理事務所が、日程や場所に関する最も信頼できる情報源です。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The late-campaign surge in political advertising is a reminder that elections are shaped by both messages and logistics.
segments.tr: 選挙戦終盤の政治広告の急増は、選挙がメッセージとロジスティクスの両方によって形作られることを思い出させます。

segments.src: Which markets get ads, which screens are targeted and which races attract outside money all reflect each side's view of where the next majority will be won or lost.
segments.tr: どの市場に広告を出し、どの画面をターゲットにし、どの選挙戦が外部資金を引き寄せるかはすべて、次の過半数がどこで勝ち取られ、あるいは失われるかという各陣営の見方を反映しています。

segments.src: By Election Day, the spending map will say a lot about what campaigns believed was in play, even before the votes are counted.
segments.tr: 投票日までに、支出マップは、開票される前であっても、各陣営が何が争点だと考えていたかについて多くを物語ることになるでしょう。

de.title: Die Midterm-Geldmaschine: Wohin die Gelder für Kampagnenwerbung in den letzten Wochen fließen

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3 less than a month away, the last stretch of the 2026 midterm campaign is also its most expensive.
segments.tr: Da der Wahltag am 3. November weniger als einen Monat entfernt ist, ist die letzte Phase des Midterm-Wahlkampfs 2026 auch die teuerste.

segments.src: Candidates, party committees and outside groups are all competing for a limited supply of airtime, inbox space and phone screens.
segments.tr: Kandidaten, Parteikomitees und externe Gruppen konkurrieren alle um ein begrenztes Angebot an Sendezeit, Posteingangsplätzen und Telefonbildschirmen.

segments.src: Here is where the money tends to go in the closing weeks, and what those choices reveal about how each side reads the political map.
segments.tr: Hier erfahren Sie, wohin das Geld in den letzten Wochen tendenziell fließt und was diese Entscheidungen darüber verraten, wie die jeweilige Seite die politische Landkarte einschätzt.

segments.src: *Note: This article is a general explainer.
segments.tr: *Hinweis: Dieser Artikel ist eine allgemeine Erklärung.

segments.src: Spending totals change daily, so check ad-tracking firms and the Federal Election Commission (FEC) for current figures.*
segments.tr: Die Ausgabensummen ändern sich täglich, prüfen Sie daher Werbe-Tracking-Firmen und die Federal Election Commission (FEC) auf aktuelle Zahlen.*

segments.src: ## Why the final weeks cost the most
segments.tr: ## Warum die letzten Wochen am meisten kosten

segments.src: Political advertising follows a predictable pattern.
segments.tr: Politische Werbung folgt einem vorhersehbaren Muster.

segments.src: Spending ramps up as Election Day approaches, and the last few weeks are the most crowded.
segments.tr: Die Ausgaben steigen an, je näher der Wahltag rückt, und die letzten Wochen sind am überfülltesten.

segments.src: There are a few reasons:
segments.tr: Es gibt einige Gründe:

segments.src: - **Voters are paying attention.** Many people tune in only when early voting begins and ballots arrive in the mail.
segments.tr: - **Wähler passen auf.** Viele Menschen schalten erst ein, wenn die vorzeitige Stimmabgabe beginnt und die Stimmzettel per Post eintreffen.

segments.src: - **Early voting compresses the calendar.** In many states, voting is already underway, so a message has to land before ballots are returned, not just before Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Die vorzeitige Stimmabgabe verkürzt den Kalender.** In vielen Bundesstaaten läuft die Stimmabgabe bereits, sodass eine Botschaft ankommen muss, bevor die Stimmzettel zurückgeschickt werden, nicht erst vor dem Wahltag.

segments.src: - **Rates rise with demand.** Broadcast stations sell time in a competitive market, and prices tend to climb when many campaigns want the same slots. Federal candidates get legal protections on the rates they pay, but outside groups often pay more.
segments.tr: - **Die Raten steigen mit der Nachfrage.** Sender verkaufen Sendezeit in einem wettbewerbsorientierten Markt, und die Preise neigen dazu, zu steigen, wenn viele Kampagnen dieselben Plätze wollen. Bundeskandidaten erhalten gesetzlichen Schutz bei den Tarifen, die sie zahlen, aber externe Gruppen zahlen oft mehr.

segments.src: ## Where the dollars go
segments.tr: ## Wohin das Geld fließt

segments.src: ### Broadcast and cable television
segments.tr: ### Broadcast- und Kabelfernsehen

segments.src: Local broadcast TV is still the largest single line item in most competitive races.
segments.tr: Lokales Broadcast-TV ist nach wie vor der größte einzelne Posten in den meisten hart umkämpften Rennen.

segments.src: It reaches older, high-turnout voters efficiently, and those voters make up a large share of midterm electorates.
segments.tr: Es erreicht ältere Wähler mit hoher Wahlbeteiligung effizient, und diese Wähler machen einen großen Anteil der Midterm-Wählerschaft aus.

segments.src: Costs are highest in expensive media markets, and a statewide race in a large state can require buying time in several of them.
segments.tr: Die Kosten sind in teuren Medienmärkten am höchsten, und ein staatsweites Rennen in einem großen Staat kann den Kauf von Sendezeit in mehreren von ihnen erfordern.

segments.src: ### Streaming and connected TV
segments.tr: ### Streaming und Connected TV

segments.src: Connected TV, which includes ads served on streaming services and smart-TV platforms, has become a fast-growing part of campaign budgets.
segments.tr: Connected TV, das Werbung auf Streaming-Diensten und Smart-TV-Plattformen umfasst, ist zu einem schnell wachsenden Teil der Kampagnenbudgets geworden.

segments.src: Its main appeal is targeting.
segments.tr: Ihr Hauptreiz ist das Targeting.

segments.src: A campaign can aim at a specific geography or audience instead of paying for every viewer in a market.
segments.tr: Eine Kampagne kann auf eine bestimmte Region oder Zielgruppe abzielen, anstatt für jeden Zuschauer in einem Markt zu bezahlen.

segments.src: Streaming does not replace broadcast, but many strategists now treat it as a complement, especially for reaching viewers who rarely watch live television.
segments.tr: Streaming ersetzt das Fernsehen nicht, aber viele Strategen betrachten es heute als Ergänzung, insbesondere um Zuschauer zu erreichen, die selten Live-Fernsehen schauen.

segments.src: ### Digital and social
segments.tr: ### Digital und Social

segments.src: Online display, search, video and social ads serve several purposes.
segments.tr: Online-Display-, Such-, Video- und Social-Ads dienen mehreren Zwecken.

segments.src: Some are persuasion messages.
segments.tr: Einige sind Überzeugungsbotschaften.

segments.src: Others raise money, recruit volunteers or remind supporters how and where to vote.
segments.tr: Andere sammeln Spenden, rekrutieren Freiwillige oder erinnern Unterstützer daran, wie und wo sie wählen können.

segments.src: Major platforms set their own rules for political ads, including disclosure requirements and, in some cases, restrictions in the final days before an election, so campaigns plan their digital calendars carefully.
segments.tr: Große Plattformen legen ihre eigenen Regeln für politische Werbung fest, einschließlich Offenlegungspflichten und in einigen Fällen Einschränkungen in den letzten Tagen vor einer Wahl, sodass Kampagnen ihre Digitalkalender sorgfältig planen.

segments.tr: Bis zum Wahltag wird die Ausgabenkarte viel darüber aussagen, was Kampagnen für machbar hielten, noch bevor die Stimmen ausgezählt sind.

vi.title: Cỗ máy tiền bạc giữa nhiệm kỳ: Nơi dòng tiền quảng cáo tranh cử đổ về trong những tuần cuối

segments.src: With Election Day on November 3 less than a month away, the last stretch of the 2026 midterm campaign is also its most expensive.
segments.tr: Với Ngày Bầu cử vào ngày 3 tháng 11 chỉ còn chưa đầy một tháng nữa, chặng cuối của chiến dịch giữa nhiệm kỳ 2026 cũng là giai đoạn tốn kém nhất.

segments.src: Candidates, party committees and outside groups are all competing for a limited supply of airtime, inbox space and phone screens.
segments.tr: Các ứng cử viên, ủy ban đảng và các nhóm bên ngoài đều đang cạnh tranh cho nguồn cung hạn chế về thời lượng phát sóng, không gian hộp thư đến và màn hình điện thoại.

segments.src: Here is where the money tends to go in the closing weeks, and what those choices reveal about how each side reads the political map.
segments.tr: Dưới đây là nơi dòng tiền thường đổ về trong những tuần cuối cùng, và những lựa chọn đó tiết lộ điều gì về cách mỗi bên đọc bản đồ chính trị.

segments.src: *Note: This article is a general explainer.
segments.tr: *Lưu ý: Bài viết này là một bài giải thích chung.

segments.src: Spending totals change daily, so check ad-tracking firms and the Federal Election Commission (FEC) for current figures.*
segments.tr: Tổng chi tiêu thay đổi hàng ngày, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra các công ty theo dõi quảng cáo và Ủy ban Bầu cử Liên bang (FEC) để biết số liệu hiện tại.*

segments.src: ## Why the final weeks cost the most
segments.tr: ## Tại sao những tuần cuối cùng lại tốn kém nhất

segments.src: Political advertising follows a predictable pattern.
segments.tr: Quảng cáo chính trị tuân theo một mô hình có thể dự đoán được.

segments.src: Spending ramps up as Election Day approaches, and the last few weeks are the most crowded.
segments.tr: Chi tiêu tăng mạnh khi Ngày Bầu cử đến gần, và vài tuần cuối cùng là thời điểm đông đúc nhất.

segments.src: There are a few reasons:
segments.tr: Có một vài lý do:

segments.src: - **Voters are paying attention.** Many people tune in only when early voting begins and ballots arrive in the mail.
segments.tr: - **Cử tri đang chú ý.** Nhiều người chỉ bắt đầu quan tâm khi bỏ phiếu sớm bắt đầu và phiếu bầu gửi qua đường bưu điện đến nơi.

segments.src: - **Early voting compresses the calendar.** In many states, voting is already underway, so a message has to land before ballots are returned, not just before Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Bỏ phiếu sớm làm rút ngắn lịch trình.** Ở nhiều tiểu bang, việc bỏ phiếu đã diễn ra, vì vậy thông điệp phải đến trước khi phiếu bầu được gửi lại, chứ không chỉ trước Ngày Bầu cử.

segments.src: - **Rates rise with demand.** Broadcast stations sell time in a competitive market, and prices tend to climb when many campaigns want the same slots. Federal candidates get legal protections on the rates they pay, but outside groups often pay more.
segments.tr: - **Giá cả tăng theo nhu cầu.** Các đài phát thanh bán thời gian trong một thị trường cạnh tranh, và giá cả có xu hướng tăng khi nhiều chiến dịch muốn có cùng một khung giờ. Các ứng cử viên liên bang nhận được sự bảo vệ pháp lý về mức giá họ phải trả, nhưng các nhóm bên ngoài thường phải trả nhiều hơn.

segments.src: ## Where the dollars go
segments.tr: ## Dòng tiền đổ về đâu

segments.src: ### Broadcast and cable television
segments.tr: ### Truyền hình phát sóng và truyền hình cáp

segments.src: Local broadcast TV is still the largest single line item in most competitive races.
segments.tr: Truyền hình phát sóng địa phương vẫn là hạng mục chi tiêu lớn nhất trong hầu hết các cuộc đua cạnh tranh.

segments.src: It reaches older, high-turnout voters efficiently, and those voters make up a large share of midterm electorates.
segments.tr: Nó tiếp cận hiệu quả những cử tri lớn tuổi, có tỷ lệ đi bầu cao, và những cử tri này chiếm một phần lớn trong số cử tri giữa nhiệm kỳ.

segments.src: Costs are highest in expensive media markets, and a statewide race in a large state can require buying time in several of them.
segments.tr: Chi phí cao nhất ở các thị trường truyền thông đắt đỏ, và một cuộc đua toàn tiểu bang ở một tiểu bang lớn có thể đòi hỏi phải mua thời lượng phát sóng ở nhiều thị trường trong số đó.

segments.src: ### Streaming and connected TV
segments.tr: ### Truyền hình trực tuyến và truyền hình kết nối

segments.src: Connected TV, which includes ads served on streaming services and smart-TV platforms, has become a fast-growing part of campaign budgets.
segments.tr: Truyền hình kết nối (Connected TV), bao gồm các quảng cáo được phân phối trên các dịch vụ phát trực tuyến và nền tảng TV thông minh, đã trở thành một phần phát triển nhanh chóng trong ngân sách chiến dịch.

segments.src: Its main appeal is targeting.
segments.tr: Sức hấp dẫn chính của nó là khả năng nhắm mục tiêu.

segments.src: A campaign can aim at a specific geography or audience instead of paying for every viewer in a market.
segments.tr: Một chiến dịch có thể nhắm vào một khu vực địa lý hoặc đối tượng cụ thể thay vì trả tiền cho mọi người xem trong một thị trường.

segments.src: Streaming does not replace broadcast, but many strategists now treat it as a complement, especially for reaching viewers who rarely watch live television.
segments.tr: Phát trực tuyến không thay thế truyền hình phát sóng, nhưng nhiều nhà chiến lược hiện coi đó là một sự bổ sung, đặc biệt là để tiếp cận những người xem hiếm khi xem truyền hình trực tiếp.

segments.src: ### Digital and social
segments.tr: ### Kỹ thuật số và mạng xã hội

segments.src: Online display, search, video and social ads serve several purposes.
segments.tr: Quảng cáo hiển thị trực tuyến, tìm kiếm, video và mạng xã hội phục vụ nhiều mục đích.

segments.src: Some are persuasion messages.
segments.tr: Một số là thông điệp thuyết phục.

segments.src: Others raise money, recruit volunteers or remind supporters how and where to vote.
segments.tr: Những thông điệp khác nhằm gây quỹ, tuyển tình nguyện viên hoặc nhắc nhở những người ủng hộ cách thức và địa điểm bỏ phiếu.

segments.src: Major platforms set their own rules for political ads, including disclosure requirements and, in some cases, restrictions in the final days before an election, so campaigns plan their digital calendars carefully.
segments.tr: Các nền tảng lớn đặt ra quy tắc riêng cho quảng cáo chính trị, bao gồm các yêu cầu công khai và trong một số trường hợp, các hạn chế trong những ngày cuối cùng trước cuộc bầu cử, vì vậy các chiến dịch lập kế hoạch lịch trình kỹ thuật số của họ một cách cẩn thận.

segments.src: ### Text, mail and direct outreach
segments.tr: ### Nhắn tin, thư từ và tiếp cận trực tiếp

segments.src: Texting, direct mail and phone outreach are less visible than TV but central to turnout efforts.
segments.tr: Nhắn tin, gửi thư trực tiếp và tiếp cận qua điện thoại ít được chú ý hơn so với TV nhưng lại là trọng tâm của các nỗ lực vận động cử tri đi bầu.

segments.src: In the closing weeks, they are used to provide polling-place information, promote early voting and urge supporters to return mail ballots.
segments.tr: Trong những tuần cuối, chúng được sử dụng để cung cấp thông tin về địa điểm bỏ phiếu, thúc đẩy bỏ phiếu sớm và kêu gọi những người ủng hộ gửi lại phiếu bầu qua thư.

segments.src: Campaigns must comply with federal and state rules on messaging and consent, and responsible operations build those compliance steps into their programs.
segments.tr: Các chiến dịch phải tuân thủ các quy tắc liên bang và tiểu bang về nhắn tin và sự đồng ý, và các hoạt động có trách nhiệm tích hợp các bước tuân thủ đó vào chương trình của họ.

segments.src: ## Which races absorb the most money
segments.tr: ## Những cuộc đua nào thu hút nhiều tiền nhất

segments.src: Ad money is not spread evenly.
segments.tr: Tiền quảng cáo không được phân bổ đều.

segments.src: It concentrates in a small number of contests that are close enough for spending to plausibly change the outcome.
segments.tr: Nó tập trung vào một số ít các cuộc tranh cử đủ sít sao để chi tiêu có thể thay đổi kết quả một cách hợp lý.

segments.src: - **Competitive U.S. Senate races.** Statewide contests in battleground states draw the most spending because they cover multiple media markets and can decide control of the chamber.
segments.tr: - **Các cuộc đua vào Thượng viện Hoa Kỳ cạnh tranh.** Các cuộc tranh cử toàn tiểu bang ở các tiểu bang chiến trường thu hút nhiều chi tiêu nhất vì chúng bao phủ nhiều thị trường truyền thông và có thể quyết định quyền kiểm soát viện này.

segments.src: - **Governor's races.** Open seats and tight contests in large states can produce enormous ad budgets.
segments.tr: - **Các cuộc đua Thống đốc.** Các ghế trống và các cuộc tranh cử sít sao ở các tiểu bang lớn có thể tạo ra ngân sách quảng cáo khổng lồ.

segments.src: - **Key U.S. House districts.** Control of the House typically turns on a few dozen competitive seats. Party committees and affiliated super PACs often spend heavily in those districts, particularly in expensive markets such as the New York and Los Angeles areas, where TV costs are high.
segments.tr: - **Các khu vực bầu cử Hạ viện Hoa Kỳ quan trọng.** Quyền kiểm soát Hạ viện thường phụ thuộc vào vài chục ghế cạnh tranh. Các ủy ban đảng và các siêu PAC liên kết thường chi tiêu mạnh tay ở những khu vực đó, đặc biệt là ở các thị trường đắt đỏ như khu vực New York và Los Angeles, nơi chi phí truyền hình rất cao.

segments.src: - **Ballot measures.** In some states, referendums and initiatives on issues such as taxes, abortion access or election rules attract eight-figure campaigns of their own.
segments.tr: - **Các biện pháp bỏ phiếu.** Ở một số tiểu bang, các cuộc trưng cầu dân ý và sáng kiến về các vấn đề như thuế, quyền tiếp cận phá thai hoặc các quy tắc bầu cử thu hút các chiến dịch có ngân sách tám con số.

segments.src: ## What the spending says about the map
segments.tr: ## Chi tiêu nói lên điều gì về bản đồ chính trị

segments.src: Strategists often say that where a group puts its money is the clearest signal of what it believes.
segments.tr: Các nhà chiến lược thường nói rằng nơi một nhóm đặt tiền của mình là tín hiệu rõ ràng nhất về những gì họ tin tưởng.

segments.src: Reading the spending patterns can offer a few clues.
segments.tr: Đọc các mô hình chi tiêu có thể cung cấp một vài manh mối.

segments.src: **Defense versus offense.** When a party or allied group books time in a district it usually wins, it is typically playing defense and worried about erosion there.
segments.tr: **Phòng thủ so với tấn công.** Khi một đảng hoặc nhóm đồng minh đặt thời lượng quảng cáo tại một khu vực mà họ thường thắng, họ thường đang chơi phòng thủ và lo lắng về sự suy giảm ở đó.

segments.src: Money in territory the other side holds suggests confidence that the seat is within reach.
segments.tr: Tiền đổ vào lãnh thổ mà bên kia đang nắm giữ cho thấy sự tự tin rằng chiếc ghế đó nằm trong tầm với.

segments.src: Shifts from week to week, such as a group canceling reservations in one race and adding them in another, are closely watched as a sign of internal polling.
segments.tr: Những thay đổi từ tuần này sang tuần khác, chẳng hạn như một nhóm hủy đặt chỗ trong một cuộc đua và thêm vào một cuộc đua khác, được theo dõi chặt chẽ như một dấu hiệu của các cuộc thăm dò nội bộ.

segments.src: **Expanding or shrinking the battlefield.** Late reservations in a race that was not on the radar months ago suggest the map is widening.
segments.tr: **Mở rộng hoặc thu hẹp chiến trường.** Những đặt chỗ muộn trong một cuộc đua không nằm trong tầm ngắm vài tháng trước cho thấy bản đồ đang mở rộng.

segments.src: Pulled reservations may mean a campaign has concluded a race is either safe or out of reach.
segments.tr: Việc rút lại các đặt chỗ có thể có nghĩa là một chiến dịch đã kết luận rằng một cuộc đua là an toàn hoặc nằm ngoài tầm với.

segments.src: **The role of outside groups.** Super PACs and other outside organizations can raise large sums and often fill gaps that candidate committees cannot, particularly because candidates and parties have contribution limits that outside groups do not.
segments.tr: **Vai trò của các nhóm bên ngoài.** Các siêu PAC và các tổ chức bên ngoài khác có thể huy động những khoản tiền lớn và thường lấp đầy những khoảng trống mà các ủy ban ứng cử viên không thể, đặc biệt là vì các ứng cử viên và đảng phái có giới hạn đóng góp mà các nhóm bên ngoài không có.

segments.src: Some of these groups disclose donors; others, such as certain nonprofits, have more limited disclosure.
segments.tr: Một số nhóm trong số này công khai nhà tài trợ; những nhóm khác, chẳng hạn như một số tổ chức phi lợi nhuận nhất định, có sự công khai hạn chế hơn.

segments.src: That is one reason transparency advocates keep a close eye on the final-month filings.
segments.tr: Đó là một lý do tại sao những người ủng hộ sự minh bạch theo dõi chặt chẽ các hồ sơ nộp trong tháng cuối cùng.

segments.src: **Candidate fundraising strength.** In some races, one candidate has a clear fundraising advantage.
segments.tr: **Sức mạnh gây quỹ của ứng cử viên.** Trong một số cuộc đua, một ứng cử viên có lợi thế gây quỹ rõ ràng.

segments.src: In others, the candidate who is behind on money is helped by party or outside spending that narrows the gap on the air.
segments.tr: Trong những cuộc đua khác, ứng cử viên đang bị tụt lại về tiền bạc được hỗ trợ bởi chi tiêu của đảng hoặc bên ngoài, giúp thu hẹp khoảng cách trên sóng truyền hình.

segments.src: ## What viewers and voters should know
segments.tr: ## Những điều người xem và cử tri nên biết

segments.src: - **Check the disclaimer.** Federal ads must state who paid for them. "Paid for by..." and "I approve this message" lines show whether an ad came from a candidate, a party committee or an outside group.
segments.tr: - **Kiểm tra tuyên bố miễn trừ trách nhiệm.** Các quảng cáo liên bang phải nêu rõ ai đã trả tiền cho chúng. Các dòng "Được trả tiền bởi..." và "Tôi chấp thuận thông điệp này" cho thấy liệu một quảng cáo đến từ một ứng cử viên, một ủy ban đảng hay một nhóm bên ngoài.

segments.src: - **Look up the sponsor.** The FEC database and state election offices publish campaign finance reports, and independent trackers publish ad-spending data.
segments.tr: - **Tra cứu nhà tài trợ.** Cơ sở dữ liệu của FEC và các văn phòng bầu cử tiểu bang công bố các báo cáo tài chính chiến dịch, và các đơn vị theo dõi độc lập công bố dữ liệu chi tiêu quảng cáo.

segments.src: - **Remember that an ad is advocacy.** Campaign ads are designed to persuade. Claims about opponents are often selective, and fact-checking organizations and nonpartisan voter guides can help provide context.
segments.tr: - **Hãy nhớ rằng quảng cáo là sự vận động.** Quảng cáo chiến dịch được thiết kế để thuyết phục. Các tuyên bố về đối thủ thường có tính chọn lọc, và các tổ chức kiểm chứng sự thật cùng các hướng dẫn cử tri phi đảng phái có thể giúp cung cấp bối cảnh.

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote.** Rules on early voting, mail ballots and registration deadlines vary by state. Your state or local election office is the most reliable source for dates and locations.
segments.tr: - **Lập kế hoạch bỏ phiếu.** Các quy tắc về bỏ phiếu sớm, phiếu bầu qua thư và thời hạn đăng ký khác nhau tùy theo tiểu bang. Văn phòng bầu cử tiểu bang hoặc địa phương của bạn là nguồn đáng tin cậy nhất về ngày tháng và địa điểm.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The late-campaign surge in political advertising is a reminder that elections are shaped by both messages and logistics.
segments.tr: Sự gia tăng quảng cáo chính trị vào cuối chiến dịch là một lời nhắc nhở rằng các cuộc bầu cử được định hình bởi cả thông điệp và hậu cần.

segments.src: Which markets get ads, which screens are targeted and which races attract outside money all reflect each side's view of where the next majority will be won or lost.
segments.tr: Thị trường nào nhận được quảng cáo, màn hình nào được nhắm mục tiêu và cuộc đua nào thu hút tiền từ bên ngoài đều phản ánh quan điểm của mỗi bên về nơi đa số tiếp theo sẽ giành chiến thắng hoặc thất bại.

segments.src: By Election Day, the spending map will say a lot about what campaigns believed was in play, even before the votes are counted.
segments.tr: Đến Ngày Bầu cử, bản đồ chi tiêu sẽ nói lên rất nhiều điều về những gì các chiến dịch tin rằng đang diễn ra, ngay cả trước khi các phiếu bầu được kiểm đếm.

segments.src: ## Why the final weeks cost the most
segments.tr: ## अंतिम हफ्तों में सबसे अधिक खर्च क्यों होता है

segments.src: Political advertising follows a predictable pattern.
segments.tr: राजनीतिक विज्ञापन एक अनुमानित पैटर्न का पालन करते हैं।

segments.src: Spending ramps up as Election Day approaches, and the last few weeks are the most crowded.
segments.tr: चुनाव का दिन नजदीक आने पर खर्च बढ़ जाता है, और आखिरी कुछ हफ्ते सबसे व्यस्त होते हैं।

segments.src: There are a few reasons:
segments.tr: इसके कुछ कारण हैं:

segments.src: - **Voters are paying attention.** Many people tune in only when early voting begins and ballots arrive in the mail.
segments.tr: - **मतदाता ध्यान दे रहे हैं।** कई लोग तभी ध्यान देते हैं जब शुरुआती मतदान शुरू होता है और मतपत्र डाक से आते हैं।

segments.src: - **Early voting compresses the calendar.** In many states, voting is already underway, so a message has to land before ballots are returned, not just before Election Day.
segments.tr: - **प्रारंभिक मतदान कैलेंडर को संक्षिप्त करता है।** कई राज्यों में, मतदान पहले से ही चल रहा है, इसलिए एक संदेश को केवल चुनाव के दिन से पहले नहीं, बल्कि मतपत्रों के वापस आने से पहले पहुंचना होगा।

segments.src: - **Rates rise with demand.** Broadcast stations sell time in a competitive market, and prices tend to climb when many campaigns want the same slots. Federal candidates get legal protections on the rates they pay, but outside groups often pay more.
segments.tr: - **मांग के साथ दरें बढ़ती हैं।** प्रसारण स्टेशन एक प्रतिस्पर्धी बाजार में समय बेचते हैं, और जब कई अभियानों को एक ही स्लॉट की आवश्यकता होती है तो कीमतें बढ़ने लगती हैं। संघीय उम्मीदवारों को उनके द्वारा भुगतान की जाने वाली दरों पर कानूनी सुरक्षा मिलती है, लेकिन बाहरी समूह अक्सर अधिक भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Where the dollars go
segments.tr: ## पैसे कहाँ जाते हैं

segments.src: ### Broadcast and cable television
segments.tr: ### प्रसारण और केबल टेलीविजन

segments.src: Local broadcast TV is still the largest single line item in most competitive races.
segments.tr: स्थानीय प्रसारण टीवी अभी भी अधिकांश प्रतिस्पर्धी दौड़ में सबसे बड़ी एकल लाइन आइटम है।

segments.src: It reaches older, high-turnout voters efficiently, and those voters make up a large share of midterm electorates.
segments.tr: यह पुराने, उच्च मतदान वाले मतदाताओं तक कुशलता से पहुंचता है, और वे मतदाता मध्यावधि मतदाताओं का एक बड़ा हिस्सा बनाते हैं।

segments.src: Costs are highest in expensive media markets, and a statewide race in a large state can require buying time in several of them.
segments.tr: महंगे मीडिया बाजारों में लागत सबसे अधिक होती है, और एक बड़े राज्य में राज्यव्यापी दौड़ के लिए उनमें से कई में समय खरीदने की आवश्यकता हो सकती है।

segments.src: ### Streaming and connected TV
segments.tr: ### स्ट्रीमिंग और कनेक्टेड टीवी

segments.src: Connected TV, which includes ads served on streaming services and smart-TV platforms, has become a fast-growing part of campaign budgets.
segments.tr: कनेक्टेड टीवी, जिसमें स्ट्रीमिंग सेवाओं और स्मार्ट-टीवी प्लेटफॉर्म पर परोसे जाने वाले विज्ञापन शामिल हैं, अभियान बजट का तेजी से बढ़ता हिस्सा बन गया है।

segments.src: Its main appeal is targeting.
segments.tr: इसका मुख्य आकर्षण लक्ष्यीकरण है।

segments.src: A campaign can aim at a specific geography or audience instead of paying for every viewer in a market.
segments.tr: एक अभियान बाजार में हर दर्शक के लिए भुगतान करने के बजाय एक विशिष्ट भूगोल या दर्शकों पर लक्षित कर सकता है।

segments.src: Streaming does not replace broadcast, but many strategists now treat it as a complement, especially for reaching viewers who rarely watch live television.
segments.tr: स्ट्रीमिंग प्रसारण की जगह नहीं लेती है, लेकिन कई रणनीतिकार अब इसे एक पूरक के रूप में मानते हैं, खासकर उन दर्शकों तक पहुंचने के लिए जो शायद ही कभी लाइव टेलीविज़न देखते हैं।

segments.src: ### Digital and social
segments.tr: ### डिजिटल और सोशल

segments.src: Online display, search, video and social ads serve several purposes.
segments.tr: ऑनलाइन डिस्प्ले, खोज, वीडियो और सामाजिक विज्ञापन कई उद्देश्यों की सेवा करते हैं।

segments.src: Some are persuasion messages.
segments.tr: कुछ अनुनय संदेश हैं।

segments.src: Others raise money, recruit volunteers or remind supporters how and where to vote.
segments.tr: अन्य लोग पैसा जुटाते हैं, स्वयंसेवकों की भर्ती करते हैं या समर्थकों को याद दिलाते हैं कि कैसे और कहाँ वोट देना है।

segments.src: Major platforms set their own rules for political ads, including disclosure requirements and, in some cases, restrictions in the final days before an election, so campaigns plan their digital calendars carefully.
segments.tr: प्रमुख प्लेटफ़ॉर्म राजनीतिक विज्ञापनों के लिए अपने स्वयं के नियम निर्धारित करते हैं, जिसमें प्रकटीकरण आवश्यकताएं और कुछ मामलों में, चुनाव से पहले के अंतिम दिनों में प्रतिबंध शामिल हैं, इसलिए अभियान अपने डिजिटल कैलेंडर की सावधानीपूर्वक योजना बनाते हैं।

segments.src: ### Text, mail and direct outreach
segments.tr: ### पाठ, मेल और प्रत्यक्ष पहुंच

segments.src: Texting, direct mail and phone outreach are less visible than TV but central to turnout efforts.
segments.tr: टेक्स्टिंग, डायरेक्ट मेल और फोन आउटरीच टीवी की तुलना में कम दिखाई देते हैं लेकिन मतदान के प्रयासों के लिए केंद्रीय हैं।

segments.src: In the closing weeks, they are used to provide polling-place information, promote early voting and urge supporters to return mail ballots.
segments.tr: अंतिम हफ्तों में, उनका उपयोग मतदान-केंद्र की जानकारी प्रदान करने, शुरुआती मतदान को बढ़ावा देने और समर्थकों से मेल मतपत्र वापस करने का आग्रह करने के लिए किया जाता है।

segments.src: Campaigns must comply with federal and state rules on messaging and consent, and responsible operations build those compliance steps into their programs.
segments.tr: अभियानों को मैसेजिंग और सहमति पर संघीय और राज्य के नियमों का पालन करना होगा, और जिम्मेदार संचालन उन अनुपालन चरणों को अपने कार्यक्रमों में बनाते हैं।

segments.src: ## Which races absorb the most money
segments.tr: ## कौन सी दौड़ सबसे ज्यादा पैसा सोखती है

segments.src: Ad money is not spread evenly.
segments.tr: विज्ञापन का पैसा समान रूप से नहीं फैला है।

segments.src: It concentrates in a small number of contests that are close enough for spending to plausibly change the outcome.
segments.tr: यह बड़ी संख्या में ऐसी प्रतियोगिताओं में केंद्रित है जो परिणाम को plausibly बदलने के लिए खर्च के लिए पर्याप्त करीब हैं।

segments.src: - **Competitive U.S. Senate races.** Statewide contests in battleground states draw the most spending because they cover multiple media markets and can decide control of the chamber.
segments.tr: - **प्रतिस्पर्धी अमेरिकी सीनेट की दौड़।** युद्ध के मैदान वाले राज्यों में राज्यव्यापी प्रतियोगिताएं सबसे अधिक खर्च आकर्षित करती हैं क्योंकि वे कई मीडिया बाजारों को कवर करती हैं और चैंबर के नियंत्रण का फैसला कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: - **Governor's races.** Open seats and tight contests in large states can produce enormous ad budgets.
segments.tr: - **गवर्नर की दौड़।** बड़े राज्यों में खुली सीटें और कड़ी प्रतिस्पर्धा भारी विज्ञापन बजट पैदा कर सकती है।

segments.src: - **Key U.S. House districts.** Control of the House typically turns on a few dozen competitive seats. Party committees and affiliated super PACs often spend heavily in those districts, particularly in expensive markets such as the New York and Los Angeles areas, where TV costs are high.
segments.tr: - **प्रमुख अमेरिकी सदन के जिले।** सदन का नियंत्रण आम तौर पर कुछ दर्जन प्रतिस्पर्धी सीटों पर निर्भर करता है। पार्टी समितियां और संबंधित सुपर पीएसी अक्सर उन जिलों में भारी खर्च करते हैं, विशेष रूप से न्यूयॉर्क और लॉस एंजिल्स क्षेत्रों जैसे महंगे बाजारों में, जहां टीवी लागत अधिक है।

segments.src: - **Ballot measures.** In some states, referendums and initiatives on issues such as taxes, abortion access or election rules attract eight-figure campaigns of their own.
segments.tr: - **मतपत्र उपाय।** कुछ राज्यों में, करों, गर्भपात तक पहुंच या चुनाव नियमों जैसे मुद्दों पर जनमत संग्रह और पहल अपने दम पर आठ-अंकों के अभियानों को आकर्षित करते हैं।

segments.src: ## What the spending says about the map
segments.tr: ## मानचित्र के बारे में खर्च क्या कहता है

segments.src: Strategists often say that where a group puts its money is the clearest signal of what it believes.
segments.tr: रणनीतिकार अक्सर कहते हैं कि कोई समूह अपना पैसा कहाँ लगाता है, यह इस बात का सबसे स्पष्ट संकेत है कि वह क्या विश्वास करता है।

segments.src: Reading the spending patterns can offer a few clues.
segments.tr: खर्च के पैटर्न को पढ़ना कुछ सुराग दे सकता है।

segments.src: **Defense versus offense.** When a party or allied group books time in a district it usually wins, it is typically playing defense and worried about erosion there.
segments.tr: **रक्षा बनाम अपराध।** जब कोई पार्टी या सहयोगी समूह किसी ऐसे जिले में समय बुक करता है जिसे वह आमतौर पर जीतता है, तो वह आमतौर पर रक्षा खेल रहा होता है और वहां क्षरण के बारे में चिंतित होता है।

segments.src: Money in territory the other side holds suggests confidence that the seat is within reach.
segments.tr: दूसरे पक्ष के पास रखे गए क्षेत्र में धन यह विश्वास दिलाता है कि सीट पहुंच के भीतर है।

segments.src: Shifts from week to week, such as a group canceling reservations in one race and adding them in another, are closely watched as a sign of internal polling.
segments.tr: हफ्ते-दर-हफ्ते बदलाव, जैसे कि एक समूह का एक दौड़ में आरक्षण रद्द करना और दूसरे में जोड़ना, आंतरिक मतदान के संकेत के रूप में बारीकी से देखे जाते हैं।

segments.src: **Expanding or shrinking the battlefield.** Late reservations in a race that was not on the radar months ago suggest the map is widening.
segments.tr: **युद्ध के मैदान का विस्तार या संकुचन।** ऐसी दौड़ में देर से आरक्षण जो महीनों पहले रडार पर नहीं था, यह बताता है कि नक्शा चौड़ा हो रहा है।

segments.src: Pulled reservations may mean a campaign has concluded a race is either safe or out of reach.
segments.tr: ख खींचे गए आरक्षण का मतलब यह हो सकता है कि एक अभियान ने निष्कर्ष निकाला है कि दौड़ या तो सुरक्षित है या पहुंच से बाहर है।

segments.src: **The role of outside groups.** Super PACs and other outside organizations can raise large sums and often fill gaps that candidate committees cannot, particularly because candidates and parties have contribution limits that outside groups do not.
segments.tr: **बाहरी समूहों की भूमिका।** सुपर पीएसी और अन्य बाहरी संगठन बड़ी रकम जुटा सकते हैं और अक्सर उन कमियों को भरते हैं जो उम्मीदवार समितियां नहीं कर सकती हैं, विशेष रूप से क्योंकि उम्मीदवारों और पार्टियों की योगदान सीमाएं हैं जो बाहरी समूहों के पास नहीं हैं।

segments.src: Some of these groups disclose donors; others, such as certain nonprofits, have more limited disclosure.
segments.tr: इनमें से कुछ समूह दानदाताओं का खुलासा करते हैं; अन्य, जैसे कि कुछ गैर-लाभकारी संस्थाएं, अधिक सीमित खुलासे हैं।

segments.src: That is one reason transparency advocates keep a close eye on the final-month filings.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि पारदर्शिता के पैरोकार अंतिम-महीने की फाइलों पर कड़ी नजर रखते हैं।

segments.src: **Candidate fundraising strength.** In some races, one candidate has a clear fundraising advantage.
segments.tr: **उम्मीदवार धन जुटाने की ताकत।** कुछ दौड़ में, एक उम्मीदवार को स्पष्ट धन जुटाने का फायदा होता है।

segments.src: In others, the candidate who is behind on money is helped by party or outside spending that narrows the gap on the air.
segments.tr: अन्य में, जो उम्मीदवार पैसे पर पीछे है, उसे पार्टी या बाहरी खर्च से मदद मिलती है जो हवा में अंतर को कम करता है।

segments.src: ## What viewers and voters should know
segments.tr: **दर्शकों और मतदाताओं को क्या पता होना चाहिए

segments.src: - **Check the disclaimer.** Federal ads must state who paid for them. "Paid for by..." and "I approve this message" lines show whether an ad came from a candidate, a party committee or an outside group.
segments.tr: - **अस्वीकरण की जाँच करें।** संघीय विज्ञापनों में यह बताना होगा कि उनके लिए किसने भुगतान किया। "इसके द्वारा भुगतान किया गया..." और "मैं इस संदेश को मंजूरी देता हूँ" लाइनें दिखाती हैं कि क्या विज्ञापन किसी उम्मीदवार, पार्टी समिति या बाहरी समूह से आया है।

segments.src: - **Look up the sponsor.** The FEC database and state election offices publish campaign finance reports, and independent trackers publish ad-spending data.
segments.tr: - **प्रायोजक को देखें।** FEC डेटाबेस और राज्य चुनाव कार्यालय अभियान वित्त रिपोर्ट प्रकाशित करते हैं, और स्वतंत्र ट्रैकर्स विज्ञापन-खर्च डेटा प्रकाशित करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Remember that an ad is advocacy.** Campaign ads are designed to persuade. Claims about opponents are often selective, and fact-checking organizations and nonpartisan voter guides can help provide context.
segments.tr: - **याद रखें कि एक विज्ञापन वकालत है।** अभियान विज्ञापनों को मनाने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है। विरोधियों के बारे में दावे अक्सर चयनात्मक होते हैं, और तथ्य-जांच संगठन और गैर-पक्षपातपूर्ण मतदाता मार्गदर्शिकाएं संदर्भ प्रदान करने में मदद कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: - **Make a plan to vote.** Rules on early voting, mail ballots and registration deadlines vary by state. Your state or local election office is the most reliable source for dates and locations.
segments.tr: - **वोट देने की योजना बनाएं।** शुरुआती मतदान, मेल मतपत्र और पंजीकरण समय सीमा पर नियम राज्य के अनुसार अलग-अलग होते हैं। तारीखों और स्थानों के लिए आपका राज्य या स्थानीय चुनाव कार्यालय सबसे विश्वसनीय स्रोत है।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: The late-campaign surge in political advertising is a reminder that elections are shaped by both messages and logistics.
segments.tr: राजनीतिक विज्ञापन में देर से अभियान की वृद्धि इस बात की याद दिलाती है कि चुनाव संदेश और रसद दोनों द्वारा आकार दिए जाते हैं।

segments.src: Which markets get ads, which screens are targeted and which races attract outside money all reflect each side's view of where the next majority will be won or lost.
segments.tr: कौन से बाजारों में विज्ञापन मिलते हैं, किन स्क्रीन को लक्षित किया जाता है और कौन सी दौड़ बाहरी धन को आकर्षित करती है, ये सभी प्रत्येक पक्ष के इस दृष्टिकोण को दर्शाते हैं कि अगला बहुमत कहाँ जीता या हारा जाएगा।

segments.src: By Election Day, the spending map will say a lot about what campaigns believed was in play, even before the votes are counted.
segments.tr: चुनाव के दिन तक, खर्च का नक्शा इस बारे में बहुत कुछ कहेगा कि अभियानों का मानना ​​था कि खेल में क्या था, इससे पहले कि वोट गिने जाएं।
